props.name: Head pops up first
props.headline: Head pops up first
props.detail: The head rises {value} body-heights by the first step (target {target}). Drive forward before you rise.

props.name: Back not flat in the stance
props.headline: Back not flat in the stance
props.detail: The back is {value} {unit} from vertical in the stance (target {target}). Lower the hips so the back is flatter.

props.name: Slow first step
props.headline: Slow first step
props.detail: The first step takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use a short, quick first step.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: The feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}).

props.name: Standing up out of the start
props.headline: Standing up out of the start
props.detail: The trunk is only {value} {unit} from vertical at the first step (target {target}). Stay low and push forward.

props.name: Throwing with the arm only
props.headline: Throwing with the arm only
props.detail: Hips and shoulders separate by {value} {unit} at stride-foot contact (target {target}). Let the hips turn before the shoulders.

props.name: Large trunk side-bend
props.headline: Large trunk side-bend
props.detail: The trunk bends {value} {unit} away from the throwing arm at release (target {target}).

props.name: Throwing elbow low
props.headline: Throwing elbow low
props.detail: The throwing shoulder is abducted {value} {unit} at stride-foot contact (target {target}). Get the elbow up to shoulder height.

props.name: Over-striding
props.headline: Over-striding
props.detail: The stride is {value} of standing height (target {target}). A shorter stride keeps the hips free to turn.

props.name: Short stride
props.headline: Short stride
props.detail: The stride is {value} of standing height (target {target}). Step towards the target to use the legs.

props.name: Slow release after the stride
props.headline: Slow release after the stride
props.detail: The ball leaves {value} {unit} after the front foot lands (target {target}).

props.name: Front leg straight at release
props.headline: Front leg straight at release
props.detail: The stride knee bends {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Throw over a softly bent front knee.

props.name: Breaking tall
props.headline: Breaking tall
props.detail: The planted knee bends only {value} {unit} (target {target}). Sink the hips to break sharply.

props.name: Knee moves inward at the break
props.headline: Knee moves inward at the break
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot as you plant (target {target}). Aim to keep the knee over the middle toes.

props.name: Leaning away from the break
props.headline: Leaning away from the break
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} away from the new direction (target {target}).

props.name: Rounded break
props.headline: Rounded break
props.detail: The planted foot stays down {value} {unit} (target {target}). Plant and push off sharply.

props.name: Aim time
props.headline: Aim time
props.detail: You aim for {value} {unit} (target {target}). If the shot is not ready in time, let down and start again rather than holding on.

props.name: Bow arm drops at release
props.headline: Bow arm drops at release
props.detail: The bow hand drops {value} of your height just after release (target {target}). Keep the bow arm up and pointing at the target until the arrow lands.

props.name: Moving while aiming
props.headline: Moving while aiming
props.detail: The head moves {value} of your height while aiming (target {target}). Settle the stance and keep the body still through the release.

props.name: Uneven shot rhythm
props.headline: Uneven shot rhythm
props.detail: Your aim time varies by {value} between arrows (target {target}). Use the same count from anchor to release every shot.

props.name: Anchor point varies
props.headline: Anchor point varies
props.detail: Your anchor moves by {value} of your height between shots (target {target}). Find the same touch point on the face every time.

props.name: Bow arm height
props.headline: Bow arm height
props.detail: The bow arm is raised {value} {unit} at the shoulder (target {target}). Keep the bow shoulder low and the arm about level with the shoulder.

props.name: Draw elbow off the arrow line
props.headline: Draw elbow off the arrow line
props.detail: The draw elbow sits {value} body-heights from the arrow line (target {target}). Bring the elbow round behind the arrow.

props.name: Bow points too high while drawing
props.headline: Bow points too high while drawing
props.detail: The arrow rises to {value} {unit} above horizontal during the draw. Draw with the bow pointing at your target so an accidental release stays in the safety zone. On the range the judge or field captain decides.

props.name: Leaning sideways
props.headline: Leaning sideways
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} sideways at full draw (target {target}). Stand tall with the shoulders level over the hips.

props.name: Leaning towards or away from the target
props.headline: Leaning towards or away from the target
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} at full draw (target {target}). Keep the body upright with the head over the line.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: Your feet are {value} times your height apart (target {target}). Stand with the feet about shoulder-width apart across the line.

props.name: Bending at the waist
props.headline: Bending at the waist
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward at contact (target {target}). Keep the chest up and hips under you.

props.name: Leaning back
props.headline: Leaning back
props.detail: The trunk leans {absValue} {unit} backwards at contact (target {target}). Run tall with a slight lean forward from the ankles.

props.name: Long time on the ground
props.headline: Long time on the ground
props.detail: Each foot stays down for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Think quick, springy contacts.

props.name: Foot lands far ahead of the hips
props.headline: Foot lands far ahead of the hips
props.detail: The foot lands {value} leg-lengths ahead of the hips (target {target}). Some reach is normal; a very long reach adds braking.

props.name: Slow step rate
props.headline: Slow step rate
props.detail: Each step takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). At the same pace, try slightly quicker, lighter steps.

props.name: Landing on a nearly straight leg
props.headline: Landing on a nearly straight leg
props.detail: The landing knee is at {value} {unit} (target {target}; 180 is straight). Let the knee stay softly bent as the foot lands.

props.name: Take-off leg not fully extended
props.headline: Take-off leg not fully extended
props.detail: The take-off knee is {value} {unit} as you leave the ground (target {target}). Push up through the whole take-off leg.

props.name: Flat take-off
props.headline: Flat take-off
props.detail: You leave the board at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Drive the free knee and chest up at take-off.

props.name: Leaning forward onto the board
props.headline: Leaning forward onto the board
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward as the take-off foot lands (target {target}). Stay tall over the last steps.

props.name: Slow take-off
props.headline: Slow take-off
props.detail: The take-off foot is down for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Plant actively and leave the board quickly.

props.name: Second-last step too short
props.headline: Second-last step too short
props.detail: The second-last step is {value} times the last step (target {target}). Make the second-last step a little longer and the last step quick and short.

props.name: Steep take-off
props.headline: Steep take-off
props.detail: You leave the board at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep running through the board rather than jumping straight up.

props.name: Long time in the blocks
props.headline: Long time in the blocks
props.detail: The push from the blocks takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push hard with both legs and leave the blocks with intent.

props.name: Reaching on the first step
props.headline: Reaching on the first step
props.detail: The shin is at {value} {unit} from horizontal as the first step lands (target {target}). Land the foot under or just behind the hips and push back.

props.name: Rear knee angle in the set
props.headline: Rear knee angle in the set
props.detail: The rear knee is at {value} {unit} in the set position (target {target}). Adjust the block spacing so the rear knee is bent but still ready to push.

props.name: Standing up too early
props.headline: Standing up too early
props.detail: The trunk is {value} {unit} from horizontal at the end of the first step (target {target}). Stay in a long forward lean and rise gradually.

props.name: Small knee drive out of the blocks
props.headline: Small knee drive out of the blocks
props.detail: The thighs are {value} {unit} apart at the end of the first step (target {target}). Drive the free knee forward as you push.

props.name: Punching across the ball
props.headline: Punching across the ball
props.detail: Your fist travels {value} {unit} off the line to the target (target {target}). Punch straight through the ball towards your target.

props.name: Ball hand moving
props.headline: Ball hand moving
props.detail: Your ball hand moves {value} of your height just before contact (target {target}). Hold the ball still on a flat hand and bring the fist to it.

props.name: Step to the target
props.headline: Step to the target
props.detail: Your step is {value} of your height (target {target}). Step towards the target with the opposite foot as you punch.

props.name: Looks like a throw
props.headline: Looks like a throw
props.detail: {value} disposal(s) looked like a throw. Hold the ball in one hand and hit it clearly with the clenched fist of the other.

props.name: Kicking-leg position at contact
props.headline: Kicking-leg position at contact
props.detail: Your kicking knee is bent {value} {unit} when you hit the ball (target {target}). Swing the lower leg fast through the ball, with the knee still slightly bent at contact.

props.name: Long ball drop
props.headline: Long ball drop
props.detail: The ball falls for {value} {unit} before contact (target {target}). Guide it down with one hand and drop it from closer to the foot.

props.name: Short follow-through
props.headline: Short follow-through
props.detail: Your kicking leg is bent {value} {unit} at the top of the follow-through (target {target}). Kick through the ball and finish with the leg long towards the target.

props.name: Support leg
props.headline: Support leg
props.detail: Your support knee is bent {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Plant the support foot beside the ball's drop line with a slightly bent, firm knee.

props.name: Marks dropped
props.headline: Marks dropped
props.detail: You secured {value} of the marks (target {target}). Watch the ball all the way into the hands.

props.name: Ball juggled
props.headline: Ball juggled
props.detail: The ball moves {value} of your height after first contact (target {target}). Reach for the ball with fingers spread and thumbs close behind it, and draw it in.

props.name: Reaching to the side
props.headline: Reaching to the side
props.detail: The ball arrives {value} of your height to the side of your chest (target {target}). Move your feet early to get in line with the ball.

props.name: Chest drops over the knee
props.headline: Chest drops over the knee
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward at the deepest point (target {target}). Keep the chest up over the hips.

props.name: Landing flat or on the toes
props.headline: Landing flat or on the toes
props.detail: The lead foot meets the floor at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Land heel first, then roll onto the whole foot.

props.name: Knee moves inward in the lunge
props.headline: Knee moves inward in the lunge
props.detail: The lead knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot (target {target}). Point the knee and the foot the same way, towards the shuttle.

props.name: Lunge depth
props.headline: Lunge depth
props.detail: The lead knee bends {value} {unit} at the deepest point (target {target}).

props.name: Short lunge
props.headline: Short lunge
props.detail: The lunge is {value} leg lengths long (target {target}). Make the last step a long stride towards the shuttle.

props.name: Slow push back from the lunge
props.headline: Slow push back from the lunge
props.detail: The lead foot stays down {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push back strongly through the heel to recover.

props.name: Bent arm at contact
props.headline: Bent arm at contact
props.detail: The elbow is at {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Reach up to meet the shuttle at full stretch.

props.name: Contact behind the head
props.headline: Contact behind the head
props.detail: The racket meets the shuttle {absValue} body-heights behind the racket shoulder (target {target}). Move behind the shuttle so you hit it slightly in front.

props.name: Low contact point
props.headline: Low contact point
props.detail: The racket head is at {value} times your height at contact (target {target}). Get behind the shuttle early and reach up to hit it.

props.name: Slow forward swing
props.headline: Slow forward swing
props.detail: The racket takes {value} {unit} from the drop to contact (target {target}). Throw the racket up at the shuttle and turn the forearm through contact.

props.name: Feet move before the shuttle is hit
props.headline: Feet move before the shuttle is hit
props.detail: A foot lifts or slides {value} time(s) before contact. Keep part of both feet still on the floor until you hit the shuttle.

props.name: Long swing for a low serve
props.headline: Long swing for a low serve
props.detail: The racket travels {value} body-heights in the swing (target {target}). Use a short, slow push of the racket forward.

props.name: Racket close to the body
props.headline: Racket close to the body
props.detail: The racket head is {value} body-heights in front of you at contact (target {target}). Hold the racket out in front of the body.

props.name: Racket stops during the serve
props.headline: Racket stops during the serve
props.detail: The racket stops or moves back {value} time(s) after the forward swing starts. Once you start forward, keep the racket moving forward.

props.name: Shuttle above 1.15 m at contact
props.headline: Shuttle above 1.15 m at contact
props.detail: The top of the shuttle is about {value} {unit} above the floor when you hit it. The whole shuttle must be below 1.15 m. In a match the service judge decides.

props.name: Secure the ball
props.headline: Secure the ball
props.detail: You bobbled {value} ball(s) (target {target}). Field with two hands, soft fingers, then bring the ball to the chest.

props.name: Quick gather
props.headline: Quick gather
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} to get to the throwing position (target {target}). Field and move into the throw in one action.

props.name: Get lower
props.headline: Get lower
props.detail: Your hips are at {value} of standing height at pick-up (target {target}). Bend the knees and hips so both hands meet the ball low and in front.

props.name: Arm slot
props.headline: Arm slot
props.detail: Your throwing arm is at {value} {unit} from the body at release (target {target}). Keep the elbow at about shoulder height.

props.name: Step to the target
props.headline: Step to the target
props.detail: Your lead foot points {value} {unit} away from the target (target {target}). Step straight at the base you are throwing to.

props.name: Slow release
props.headline: Slow release
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} from pick-up to release (target {target}). Bring the ball straight to the throwing position as you step.

props.name: Turn into the hit
props.headline: Turn into the hit
props.detail: Your trunk turns {value} {unit} into the hit (target {target}). Step towards the field and rotate the hips and shoulders through contact.

props.name: Out of the box
props.headline: Out of the box
props.detail: On {value} hit(s) a foot left the box before the ball left your hand. Step within the box and hit, then run.

props.name: Short or foul
props.headline: Short or foul
props.detail: {value} hit(s) bounced first before the no-hit line or in foul territory. Hit through the ball towards the middle of the field.

props.name: Soft contact
props.headline: Soft contact
props.detail: The ball leaves your hand at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Make firm contact with the palm or fist and follow through.

props.name: Hands far from the body
props.headline: Hands far from the body
props.detail: The hands are {value} of standing height from the pelvis at contact (target {target}). Keep the hands inside the ball.

props.name: Hands close to the body at contact
props.headline: Hands close to the body at contact
props.detail: The hands are {value} of standing height from the pelvis at contact (target {target}). Extend through the ball.

props.name: Head moves before contact
props.headline: Head moves before contact
props.detail: The head travels {value} body-heights from load to contact (target {target}). Keep the head quiet.

props.name: Hips stop turning early
props.headline: Hips stop turning early
props.detail: The pelvis rotates {value} {unit} by contact (target {target}). Let the back hip drive through.

props.name: Stride timing
props.headline: Stride timing
props.detail: Contact comes {value} {unit} after the front foot lands (target {target}).

props.name: Throwing arm out of position at foot contact
props.headline: Throwing arm out of position at foot contact
props.detail: The throwing shoulder is abducted {value} {unit} as the front foot lands (target {target}). The arm should be up at about shoulder height.

props.name: Arm angle at release
props.headline: Arm angle at release
props.detail: The throwing shoulder is abducted {value} {unit} at release (target {target}).

props.name: Large sideways trunk tilt
props.headline: Large sideways trunk tilt
props.detail: The trunk tilts {value} {unit} towards the glove side at release (target {target}).

props.name: Stride foot direction
props.headline: Stride foot direction
props.detail: The stride foot lands {value} {unit} from the target line (target {target}).

props.name: Front leg keeps bending
props.headline: Front leg keeps bending
props.detail: The lead knee bends a further {absValue} {unit} after foot contact. Let the front leg firm up as you throw.

props.name: Short stride
props.headline: Short stride
props.detail: The stride is {value} of standing height (target {target}). Stride further towards the plate to use the legs.

props.name: Lead leg lands straight
props.headline: Lead leg lands straight
props.detail: The lead knee is bent {value} {unit} at foot contact (target {target}). Land with a softly bent front knee.

props.name: Upright at release
props.headline: Upright at release
props.detail: The trunk tilts forward {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Finish over the front leg.

props.name: Unusual elbow bend in the downswing
props.headline: Unusual elbow bend in the downswing
props.detail: The pitching elbow bends {value} {unit} in the downswing (target {target}). Ask your coach to check the arm circle.

props.name: Leap before the pitch
props.headline: Leap before the pitch
props.detail: Both feet leave the ground {value} times before release. Push off and drag the pivot foot instead of leaping.

props.name: Posture at release
props.headline: Posture at release
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Stay tall through the release.

props.name: Release above the hip
props.headline: Release above the hip
props.detail: The pitching hand is {value} body-heights above the hip at release. Under most fastpitch rules the release must be below the hip.

props.name: Short stride
props.headline: Short stride
props.detail: The stride is {value} of standing height (target {target}). Drive harder off the plate.

props.name: Stride knee at landing
props.headline: Stride knee at landing
props.detail: The stride knee is bent {value} {unit} at landing (target {target}).

props.name: Bending at the waist
props.headline: Bending at the waist
props.detail: The trunk leans forward {value} {unit} (target {target}). Bend the knees and keep the chest up.

props.name: Popping up during the slide
props.headline: Popping up during the slide
props.detail: The hips move up and down by {value} body-heights during the slide (target {target}). Stay at the same low height.

props.name: Feet cross during the slide
props.headline: Feet cross during the slide
props.detail: The feet cross or click together {value} times. Step with the lead foot and slide the trail foot without crossing.

props.name: Stance too narrow
props.headline: Stance too narrow
props.detail: The feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}). A wider base makes it easier to move either way.

props.name: Standing too tall
props.headline: Standing too tall
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} in the stance (target {target}). Sit lower so you can react faster.

props.name: Jumping out instead of up
props.headline: Jumping out instead of up
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} at take-off (target {target}). Jump up towards the backboard, not under it.

props.name: Ball released low
props.headline: Ball released low
props.detail: The ball leaves the hand {value} body-heights above the head (target {target}). Reach high and use the backboard.

props.name: Drive knee stays low
props.headline: Drive knee stays low
props.detail: The free knee lifts to {value} {unit} at take-off (target {target}). Drive it up to lift towards the rim.

props.name: Landing with stiff legs
props.headline: Landing with stiff legs
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Land softly with bent knees.

props.name: Extra step after the gather
props.headline: Extra step after the gather
props.detail: There are {value} steps between gathering the ball and releasing it. The rules allow two.

props.name: Knees move inward on landing
props.headline: Knees move inward on landing
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot as you land (target {target}). Aim to keep the knees over the middle toes.

props.name: Landing with stiff legs
props.headline: Landing with stiff legs
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} as you land (target {target}). Land softly and let the knees and hips bend.

props.name: Trunk tilts to one side on landing
props.headline: Trunk tilts to one side on landing
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} to the side (target {target}). Land with the chest centred over both feet.

props.name: One leg takes more of the landing
props.headline: One leg takes more of the landing
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} differently on landing (target {target}). Share the landing evenly between both legs.

props.name: Shooting elbow flares out
props.headline: Shooting elbow flares out
props.detail: The elbow sits {value} body-heights to the side of the ball at the dip (target {target}). Keep the elbow under the ball so it travels straight.

props.name: Foot crosses the line too early
props.headline: Foot crosses the line too early
props.detail: The front foot moves {value} body-heights past the free-throw line before the ball reaches the ring. Stay behind the line until the ball touches the ring.

props.name: Release angle varies
props.headline: Release angle varies
props.detail: The release angle varies by {value} {unit} across free throws (target {target}). The same routine every time helps.

props.name: Follow-through not held
props.headline: Follow-through not held
props.detail: The wrist finishes flexed only {value} {unit} (target {target}). Hold the finish with the fingers pointing at the rim.

props.name: Little bend in the legs
props.headline: Little bend in the legs
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} at the dip (target {target}). Use the legs so the arms do not have to force the shot.

props.name: Release angle outside the best range
props.headline: Release angle outside the best range
props.detail: The ball leaves at {value} {unit} above horizontal (target {target}). A flatter or much higher arc leaves less room at the rim.

props.name: Routine takes too long
props.headline: Routine takes too long
props.detail: The shot leaves the hands {value} {unit} after the set position (target {target}). The rules allow 5 seconds.

props.name: Drifting sideways on the jump
props.headline: Drifting sideways on the jump
props.detail: The landing is {value} body-heights to the side of the take-off (target {target}). Jump up, not across.

props.name: Flat shot
props.headline: Flat shot
props.detail: The ball leaves at {value} {unit} above horizontal (target {target}). More arc gives the ball a bigger target at the rim.

props.name: Release angle varies
props.headline: Release angle varies
props.detail: The release angle varies by {value} {unit} across shots (target {target}).

props.name: Leaning at release
props.headline: Leaning at release
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Rise straight up and stay balanced.

props.name: Low release point
props.headline: Low release point
props.detail: The ball is released at {value} times standing height (target {target}). Release higher, above the forehead.

props.name: Release timing off the top of the jump
props.headline: Release timing off the top of the jump
props.detail: The ball leaves {value} {unit} after take-off (target {target}). Release at or just before the top of the jump.

props.name: Little knee bend before the jump
props.headline: Little knee bend before the jump
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at the lowest point (target {target}). A fuller load helps range without forcing the arms.

props.name: Distance from the jack
props.headline: Distance from the jack
props.detail: Your balls stop a median {value} {unit} from the jack (target {target}). Check the ramp height and release point calls.

props.name: Ramp operator looked
props.headline: Ramp operator looked
props.detail: The ramp operator turned to look into the court {value} time(s), which is penalised. Agree calls so the operator never needs to look.

props.name: Ramp over the line
props.headline: Ramp over the line
props.detail: The ramp was over the throwing line at release {value} time(s). Check the ramp end sits behind the line before each ball.

props.name: Ramp swing too small
props.headline: Ramp swing too small
props.detail: Before the jack the ramp swung only {value} {unit} each way (target {target}). Make a clear swing left and right before the jack, penalty balls and tie-breaks.

props.name: Long set-up
props.headline: Long set-up
props.detail: Set-up took a median {value} {unit} per ball (target {target}). A fixed call routine saves time on the end clock.

props.name: Release point varies
props.headline: Release point varies
props.detail: Your hand height at release varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same set-up every throw.

props.name: Jack not valid
props.headline: Jack not valid
props.detail: {value} jack(s) stopped short of the V line or left the court, which hands the jack to your opponent. Practise a safe minimum length first.

props.name: Jack length varies
props.headline: Jack length varies
props.detail: Your jack lands within a spread of {value} {unit} for the same called length (target {target}). Pick your length and repeat the same swing.

props.name: Off the seat at release
props.headline: Off the seat at release
props.detail: On {value} throw(s) you had no contact with the seat at release. Keep at least one buttock on the seat as the jack leaves your hand.

props.name: Short arm swing
props.headline: Short arm swing
props.detail: Your elbow is at {value} {unit} when you let go (target {target}, to be adjusted with your coach for your class). Let the arm swing long and smooth like a pendulum.

props.name: Release point varies
props.headline: Release point varies
props.detail: Your hand height at release varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same set-up and swing every throw.

props.name: Distance from the jack
props.headline: Distance from the jack
props.detail: Your balls stop a median {value} {unit} from the jack (target {target}). Work on length control with the target ladder.

props.name: Touching outside the box
props.headline: Touching outside the box
props.detail: On {value} throw(s) your foot, hand or chair touched the court outside your box at release. Set up so everything stays inside your box until the ball has gone.

props.name: Off the seat at release
props.headline: Off the seat at release
props.detail: On {value} throw(s) you had no contact with the seat at release, which the referee penalises. Keep at least one buttock on the seat as the ball leaves your hand.

props.name: Foot fault
props.headline: Foot fault
props.detail: On {value} delivery(ies) neither foot was on or above the mat at release. Keep part of your back foot on the mat until the bowl has gone.

props.name: Release varies
props.headline: Release varies
props.detail: Your hand height at release varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Let the bowl leave the hand close to the green each time.

props.name: Distance from the jack
props.headline: Distance from the jack
props.detail: Your bowls stop a median {value} {unit} from the jack (target {target}). Work on line and length with the target mat drill.

props.name: Body angle at release
props.headline: Body angle at release
props.detail: Your trunk bends {value} {unit} to the side at release (target {target}). Stay balanced over the front foot and keep the body square to your line.

props.name: Release varies
props.headline: Release varies
props.detail: Your release height varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same chair angle and swing each time.

props.name: Distance from the jack
props.headline: Distance from the jack
props.detail: Your bowls stop a median {value} {unit} from the jack (target {target}). Work on line and length with the target mat drill.

props.name: Wheel off the mat
props.headline: Wheel off the mat
props.detail: On {value} delivery(ies) no wheel was on or above the mat at release. Set the chair with one wheel on the mat before each bowl.

props.name: Jack not in play
props.headline: Jack not in play
props.detail: {value} jack(s) finished short of 23 m, in the ditch or off the rink, which hands the jack to your opponent. Build a safe minimum length first.

props.name: Foot fault on the jack
props.headline: Foot fault on the jack
props.detail: On {value} jack delivery(ies) no foot was on or above the mat. The same rule applies as for bowls.

props.name: Jack length varies
props.headline: Jack length varies
props.detail: Your jack lands within a spread of {value} {unit} for the same called length (target {target}). Use the same step and swing; change only the pace.

props.name: Mat position
props.headline: Mat position
props.detail: The mat was placed off the centre line or under 2 m from the rear ditch {value} time(s). Measure from the ditch and line it up before delivering the jack.

props.name: Arms at different heights
props.headline: Arms at different heights
props.detail: Your arms differ by {value} {unit} at the hits (target {target}). Check both arms in the mirror and hit the same angle on each side.

props.name: Bent arms
props.headline: Bent arms
props.detail: Your elbows are at {value} {unit} in straight-arm motions (target {target}). Reach long through the fingertips.

props.name: Motions bouncing
props.headline: Motions bouncing
props.detail: Your hands move {value} of your height while holding a motion (target {target}). Stop dead on the count and hold.

props.name: Motions not sharp
props.headline: Motions not sharp
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} to reach each motion (target {target}). Move the arms fast and arrive on the count.

props.name: Chest dropping
props.headline: Chest dropping
props.detail: You lean forward {value} {unit} at the top (target {target}). Keep the chest up and bring the legs up to the arms.

props.name: More height
props.headline: More height
props.detail: You are in the air for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Drive up from both feet after the whip so you have time to hit the shape.

props.name: Legs below level
props.headline: Legs below level
props.detail: Your legs open to {value} {unit} at the top (target {target}). Lift the legs up and out to the side, knees and toes facing up, and keep working your flexibility.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: Your knees bend only {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Snap the legs together and land with soft knees, feet together.

props.name: Passe position
props.headline: Passe position
props.detail: Your gesture toe sits {value} of your height from the support knee (target {target}). Bring the toe to the knee quickly and hold it there.

props.name: Turn not finished cleanly
props.headline: Turn not finished cleanly
props.detail: You rotated {value} {unit} (target {target}). Spot the front and finish facing where you started.

props.name: Tipping off the axis
props.headline: Tipping off the axis
props.detail: Your body tilts up to {value} {unit} during the turn (target {target}). Stack the shoulders over the hips over the support foot and pull up through the top of the head.

props.name: Wobbly finish
props.headline: Wobbly finish
props.detail: Your finish wobbles by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Land the gesture foot in a controlled position and hold it.

props.name: Bent arms while still
props.headline: Bent arms while still
props.detail: The elbows are at {value} {unit} when you hold still (target {target}). Hang on straight arms and let the legs do the work.

props.name: Feet slipping
props.headline: Feet slipping
props.detail: Your feet slip {value} time(s). Look at each foothold and place the foot precisely and quietly.

props.name: Hips away from the wall
props.headline: Hips away from the wall
props.detail: The hips are {value} body-heights from the wall (target {target}). Turn a hip in or bring the hips closer so your weight stays over your feet.

props.name: Letting go from high up
props.headline: Letting go from high up
props.detail: Your feet are {value} times your height above the mat when you let go (target {target}). Climb down most of the way before you step or drop.

props.name: Landing stance
props.headline: Landing stance
props.detail: Your feet are {value} times your height apart on landing (target {target}). Land with the feet about shoulder-width apart.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Land on your feet and bend the knees, then sit or roll back if you need to.

props.name: Jerky movement
props.headline: Jerky movement
props.detail: Your hip movement scores {value} for jerkiness (target {target}). Move the hips smoothly over the feet; repeat the problem to make it flow.

props.name: Long pauses
props.headline: Long pauses
props.detail: You are still for {value}% of the climb (target {target}). Rest where it is easy, on straight arms, and move steadily between rests.

props.name: Searching for holds
props.headline: Searching for holds
props.detail: You touch {value} holds per 10 moves without using them (target {target}). Read the problem from the ground first and plan each hand and foot.

props.name: Arm-only punch
props.headline: Arm-only punch
props.detail: The hips move {value} body-heights forward as you punch (target {target}). Push off the rear foot and drive the rear hip through.

props.name: Arm reach
props.headline: Arm reach
props.detail: The rear elbow is at {value} {unit} at full reach (target {target}). Punch to a target you can reach without leaning or over-straightening.

props.name: Guard drops
props.headline: Guard drops
props.detail: The other hand is {value} body-heights from the chin as you punch (target {target}). Keep the lead hand up by the chin.

props.name: Little body turn
props.headline: Little body turn
props.detail: The trunk turns {value} {unit} towards the target (target {target}). Turn the rear shoulder through to the target.

props.name: Slow punch
props.headline: Slow punch
props.detail: The punch takes {value} {unit} to reach full extension (target {target}). Start from a relaxed guard and snap the punch out.

props.name: Slow return to guard
props.headline: Slow return to guard
props.detail: The hand takes {value} {unit} to come back (target {target}). Bring it straight back along the same line.

props.name: Arm position in the slap
props.headline: Arm position in the slap
props.detail: The arms are {value} {unit} from the body at the slap (target {target}). Slap with straight arms about 30-45 degrees from the body, palms down.

props.name: Chin not tucked
props.headline: Chin not tucked
props.detail: The neck is bent {value} {unit} forward as the back lands (target {target}). Keep the chin on the chest throughout the fall.

props.name: Head comes close to the mat
props.headline: Head comes close to the mat
props.detail: The head drops to {value} body-heights above the mat (target {target}). Tuck the chin to the chest and look at your belt as you roll back. Practise from a lower start with your coach.

props.name: Arm slap timing
props.headline: Arm slap timing
props.detail: The arms hit the mat {value} {unit} from the back landing (target {target}). Slap the mat as the back lands.

props.name: Leg bent at contact
props.headline: Leg bent at contact
props.detail: The kicking knee is at {value} {unit} at impact (target {target}). Extend through the pad with the top of the foot.

props.name: Leg swings as one piece
props.headline: Leg swings as one piece
props.detail: The foot reaches top speed {value} {unit} after the knee (target {target}). Lead with the knee, then whip the lower leg.

props.name: Low knee chamber
props.headline: Low knee chamber
props.detail: The kicking knee rises to {value} body-heights from hip level (target {target}). Lift the knee to hip height before kicking.

props.name: Support foot does not turn
props.headline: Support foot does not turn
props.detail: The support foot turns {value} {unit} (target {target}). Turn on the ball of the support foot as you kick.

props.name: Slow kick
props.headline: Slow kick
props.detail: The kick takes {value} {unit} from first movement to impact (target {target}). Lift the knee and snap the kick out in one motion.

props.name: Blade ahead of the hands
props.headline: Blade ahead of the hands
props.detail: The bat angle is {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Keep the handle ahead so the ball goes down.

props.name: Front-foot timing off
props.headline: Front-foot timing off
props.detail: The front foot lands {value} {unit} before contact (target {target}).

props.name: Gap between bat and pad
props.headline: Gap between bat and pad
props.detail: The bat is {value} body-heights to the side of the front pad at contact (target {target}). Keep bat and pad together.

props.name: Head behind the front knee
props.headline: Head behind the front knee
props.detail: The head is {absValue} body-heights behind the front knee at contact (target {target}). Lead with the head towards the ball.

props.name: Short front stride
props.headline: Short front stride
props.detail: The stride is {value} of standing height (target {target}). Get closer to the pitch of the ball.

props.name: Front leg straight at contact
props.headline: Front leg straight at contact
props.detail: The front knee bends only {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Bend the front knee and get the weight forward.

props.name: Balance shifts after the shot
props.headline: Balance shifts after the shot
props.detail: The hips sway {value} body-heights after impact (target {target}).

props.name: Front foot lands early
props.headline: Front foot lands early
props.detail: The front foot is down {value} {unit} before impact (target {target}), which can limit bat speed.

props.name: Head behind the front knee at impact
props.headline: Head behind the front knee at impact
props.detail: The head is {absValue} body-heights behind the front knee at impact.

props.name: Body drifts off the line after release
props.headline: Body drifts off the line after release

props.name: Front knee softens between contact and release

props.name: Front foot lands over the crease

props.name: Arm angle varies

props.name: Hips stop rotating early

props.name: Low arm at release

props.detail: The bowling arm is {value} {unit} from vertical at release (target {target}).

props.name: Throwing with the arm only

props.detail: Hips and shoulders separate by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Turn side-on and lead with the hips.

props.name: Throwing elbow below the shoulder

props.detail: The elbow is {absValue} body-heights below shoulder height as the front foot lands (target {target}). Get the elbow up to shoulder height.

props.name: Short throwing stride

props.name: Upright at release

props.name: Cue not level

props.name: Both feet off the floor

props.name: Rushed change of direction

props.detail: You pause for {value} {unit} at the back (target {target}). Let the cue settle at the end of the last backswing before you go through.

props.name: Short follow-through
props.headline: Short follow-through
props.detail: The cue tip travels {value} of your height past the ball (target {target}). Accelerate through the cue ball and let the cue finish on line.

props.name: Upper arm moving
props.headline: Upper arm moving
props.detail: Your cue-arm shoulder moves {value} {unit} during the delivery (target {target}). Keep the upper arm still and let the forearm do the work.

props.name: Bridge distance
props.headline: Bridge distance
props.detail: Your bridge hand is {value} of your height from the cue ball (target {target}). Set the bridge at a steady distance and press it firmly into the cloth.

props.name: Front knee
props.headline: Front knee
props.detail: Your front knee is bent {value} {unit} (target {target}). Brace the back leg and soften the front knee so you feel balanced and still.

props.name: Head high above the cue
props.headline: Head high above the cue
props.detail: Your head sits {value} of your height above the cue hand (target {target}). Get down lower so your sighting eye is over the line of the cue.

props.name: Standing too upright
props.headline: Standing too upright
props.detail: Your trunk leans {value} {unit} over the cue (target {target}). Bend forward from the hips so your eye comes down over the cue.

props.name: Hitting a different spot each time
props.headline: Hitting a different spot each time
props.detail: Your tip height at contact varies by {value} of your height (target {target}). Fix the bridge height and cue level before each shot.

props.name: Head moving on the shot
props.headline: Head moving on the shot
props.detail: Your head moves {value} of your height as you deliver the cue (target {target}). Keep your eyes on the object ball and your head still until the cue ball has gone.

props.name: Getting up too soon
props.headline: Getting up too soon
props.detail: You come up {value} {unit} after contact (target {target}). Stay down and watch the object ball into the pocket.

props.name: Uneven delivery timing
props.headline: Uneven delivery timing
props.detail: Your delivery timing varies by {value} from shot to shot (target {target}). Use the same feathers, the same pause and the same pace each time.

props.name: Hog-line violation
props.headline: Hog-line violation
props.detail: On {value} delivery(ies) you still held the stone at the hog line, so it would be removed. Release earlier, well before the line.

props.name: Off the line
props.headline: Off the line
props.detail: The stone drifts {value} {unit} off your target line by release (target {target}). Set up square to the skip's brush and slide straight at it.

props.name: Pace varies
props.headline: Pace varies
props.detail: Your hog-to-hog time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same backswing and leg drive for the same shot.

props.name: Slide balance
props.headline: Slide balance
props.detail: Your trunk sways {value} {unit} during the slide (target {target}). Stay balanced over the sliding foot with a steady trailing leg.

props.name: Wrong hack
props.headline: Wrong hack
props.detail: You delivered from the wrong hack {value} time(s). Use the hack on the opposite side of the centre line to your delivery hand.

props.name: Get over the brush
props.headline: Get over the brush
props.detail: Your shoulders are {value} {unit} from the brush head (target {target}). Move the upper body over the brush so you can press down.

props.name: Slow strokes
props.headline: Slow strokes
props.detail: Each brush stroke takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Shorten the stroke and keep the brush head moving quickly.

props.name: Uneven strokes
props.headline: Uneven strokes
props.detail: Your stroke time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Find a steady rhythm while walking with the stone.

props.name: Chair moving
props.headline: Chair moving
props.detail: The chair moved during {value} delivery(ies). Make sure it is still before you swing; a team-mate may steady it if your club allows.

props.name: Hog-line violation
props.headline: Hog-line violation
props.detail: On {value} delivery(ies) the stone was not released before the hog line. Set up so the release comes well before the line.

props.name: Off the line
props.headline: Off the line
props.detail: The stone drifts {value} {unit} off your target line (target {target}). Line up the chair and stick with the skip's brush before the swing.

props.name: Pace varies
props.headline: Pace varies
props.detail: Your stone travel time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same backswing length for the same shot.

props.name: Bike drifts when looking behind
props.headline: Bike drifts when looking behind
props.detail: The bike moves {value} body-heights sideways as you look back (target {target}). Keep both hands steady on the bars and look with the head, not the shoulders.

props.name: Bike drifts when signalling
props.headline: Bike drifts when signalling
props.detail: The bike moves {value} body-heights sideways while you signal (target {target}). Hold the bars firmly with the other hand and keep pedalling smoothly.

props.name: Signal arm position
props.headline: Signal arm position
props.detail: The signalling arm is raised {value} {unit} (target {target}). Hold the arm straight out to the side at shoulder height.

props.name: Quick glance only
props.headline: Quick glance only
props.detail: The head turns {value} {unit} (target {target}). Turn far enough to see what is behind you.

props.name: Using feet to stop
props.headline: Using feet to stop
props.detail: A foot touches the ground {absValue} {unit} before the bike stops (target {target}). Squeeze both brakes to stop, then put a foot down.

props.name: Slow to find the pedals
props.headline: Slow to find the pedals
props.detail: Both feet reach the pedals {value} {unit} after setting off (target {target}). Start with one pedal raised and ready.

props.name: Wobbly start
props.headline: Wobbly start
props.detail: The bike moves {value} body-heights side to side after setting off (target {target}). Start with a pedal at the 2 o'clock position, push down firmly and look ahead.

props.name: Cadence
props.headline: Cadence
props.detail: Each pedal revolution takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Choose a gear that lets you pedal smoothly at a steady rhythm.

props.name: Hips rocking on the saddle
props.headline: Hips rocking on the saddle
props.detail: The hips move {value} body-heights side to side (target {target}). Hip rocking can be a sign the saddle position needs checking; ask a coach or bike fitter.

props.name: Knee bend at the bottom of the stroke
props.headline: Knee bend at the bottom of the stroke
props.detail: The knee bends {value} {unit} at the bottom of the pedal stroke (target {target}). This points to a saddle that may be too high or too low; ask a coach or bike fitter to check it.

props.name: Changing leg position
props.headline: Changing leg position
props.detail: The knee angle at the bottom of the stroke varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Sit still and pedal in smooth circles.

props.name: Head moving
props.headline: Head moving
props.detail: Your head moves {value} of your height during the throw (target {target}). Keep your eyes on the target and your head still until the dart lands.

props.name: Release point varies
props.headline: Release point varies
props.detail: Your hand height at release varies by {value} of your height (target {target}). Use the same set position and draw back to the same point for every dart.

props.name: Uneven rhythm
props.headline: Uneven rhythm
props.detail: Your throw timing varies by {value} from dart to dart (target {target}). Keep the same smooth tempo; don't rush the third dart.

props.name: Body moving on the throw
props.headline: Body moving on the throw
props.detail: Your body moves {value} of your height in the moment before release (target {target}). Set your weight on the front foot and keep the body still; only the arm throws.

props.name: Lean
props.headline: Lean
props.detail: You lean {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Find a lean you can hold still and balanced for every dart.

props.name: Foot over the oche
props.headline: Foot over the oche
props.detail: A foot was on or over the oche for {value} dart(s). Under the rules those darts would not score after a warning. Set your front foot just behind the line before each visit.

props.name: Elbow lifting
props.headline: Elbow lifting
props.detail: Your elbow lifts {value} of your height during the throw (target {target}). Keep the elbow as the steady pivot; it can rise a little only at the very end.

props.name: Elbow action
props.headline: Elbow action
props.detail: Your elbow straightens {value} {unit} on the throw (target {target}). Draw back to the same point each time and push smoothly through to the target.

props.name: Arm stops early
props.headline: Arm stops early
props.detail: Your elbow is at {value} {unit} when the arm stops (target {target}). Follow through with the hand pointing at the target after the dart leaves.

props.name: Upper arm moving
props.headline: Upper arm moving
props.detail: Your throwing shoulder moves {value} {unit} during the throw (target {target}). Keep the upper arm still and let the forearm swing from the elbow.

props.name: Arm position
props.headline: Arm position
props.detail: Your throwing arm is {value} {unit} from your body at release (target {target}). Lift the elbow to about shoulder height and throw over the top.

props.name: Held the ball too long
props.headline: Held the ball too long
props.detail: You held a ball for {value} {unit}, over the throw clock. Pick a target early and release within the time.

props.name: Turn the hips first
props.headline: Turn the hips first
props.detail: Your hips and shoulders turn together ({value} {unit} apart, target {target}). Step and turn the hips to the target, then bring the shoulders and arm through.

props.name: Step into the throw
props.headline: Step into the throw
props.detail: Your step is {value} of your height (target {target}). Step towards the target with the opposite foot.

props.name: Foot out of court
props.headline: Foot out of court
props.detail: A foot was out of court on {value} catch(es), which is out. Set your feet inside the lines before the ball arrives.

props.name: Catches dropped
props.headline: Catches dropped
props.detail: You secured {value} of the catches (target {target}). Watch the ball into your hands and hug it to your chest.

props.name: Reaching to the side
props.headline: Reaching to the side
props.detail: The ball arrives {value} of your height to the side (target {target}). Move your feet to get your body behind it.

props.name: Stiff arms
props.headline: Stiff arms
props.detail: Your elbows bend only {value} {unit} as you catch (target {target}). Give with the ball and pull it in.

props.name: Dodged out of court
props.headline: Dodged out of court
props.detail: You left the court on {value} dodge(s), which is out. Stay a step inside the lines so you have room to move.

props.name: Moving late
props.headline: Moving late
props.detail: You start moving {value} {unit} after the throw (target {target}). Watch the thrower's arm, not the ball in their hand, and move as it comes forward.

props.name: Ready stance
props.headline: Ready stance
props.detail: Your knees are bent {value} {unit} as the ball is thrown (target {target}). Bend the knees and stay on the balls of your feet.

props.name: Arm not fully extended
props.headline: Arm not fully extended
props.detail: The elbow reaches {value} {unit} (target {target}). Reach fully so the arm is straight as the point arrives.

props.name: Hand height
props.headline: Hand height
props.detail: The sword hand is {value} body-heights from shoulder level (target {target}). Extend with the hand at about shoulder height.

props.name: Slow arm extension
props.headline: Slow arm extension
props.detail: The arm takes {value} {unit} to straighten (target {target}). Extend smoothly and quickly from the shoulder, without pulling the arm back first.

props.name: Back leg not fully pushed
props.headline: Back leg not fully pushed
props.detail: The rear knee reaches {value} {unit} (target {target}). Drive through the back leg until it is straight, back foot flat.

props.name: Foot moves before the arm
props.headline: Foot moves before the arm
props.detail: The front foot lifts {absValue} {unit} before the sword arm starts. Start the arm extension first, then lunge.

props.name: Front-knee bend
props.headline: Front-knee bend
props.detail: The front knee bends {value} {unit} at the end of the lunge (target {target}). Land with the front shin about upright and the knee over the heel.

props.name: Short lunge
props.headline: Short lunge
props.detail: The front foot travels {value} leg lengths (target {target}). Kick the front foot forward low and push hard from the back leg.

props.name: Bouncing up and down
props.headline: Bouncing up and down
props.detail: The hips move {value} of your height up and down (target {target}). Glide: keep the head and hips level as you step.

props.name: Feet cross
props.headline: Feet cross
props.detail: The rear foot passes the front foot {value} time(s). Front foot moves first on an advance, rear foot first on a retreat; the feet never cross. At sabre, crossing forward is not allowed.

props.name: Leaning forward
props.headline: Leaning forward
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward (target {target}). Stay upright with the weight centred.

props.name: Standing too tall
props.headline: Standing too tall
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} on guard (target {target}). Sit lower with the knees bent and the weight between the feet.

props.name: Base width
props.headline: Base width
props.detail: The feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}).

props.name: Tackling from too high
props.headline: Tackling from too high
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at the tackle (target {target}). Get low with a wide base before you block.

props.name: Stick too upright
props.headline: Stick too upright
props.detail: The stick is at {value} {unit} from the ground (target {target}). Lay the stick low and flat across the ball's path.

props.name: Backswing before the push
props.headline: Backswing before the push
props.detail: The stick moves {value} body-heights back from the ball before the push (target {target}). Keep the stick on the ball and push through it.

props.name: High follow-through
props.headline: High follow-through
props.detail: The stick head finishes {value} body-heights off the ground (target {target}). Follow through low along the line of the pass.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: The feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}). Use a wide, stable base.

props.name: Standing tall
props.headline: Standing tall
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Get low with the head over the ball.

props.name: Lead knee at landing
props.headline: Lead knee at landing
props.detail: The lead knee is at {value} {unit} as the front foot lands (target {target}). Land on a slightly bent lead leg, then drive through it.

props.name: Short final stride
props.headline: Short final stride
props.detail: The feet are {value} times your height apart at release (target {target}). Make the last stride long and low.

props.name: Short drag
props.headline: Short drag
props.detail: The ball stays on the stick for {value} times your height (target {target}). Start the drag behind the body and keep the ball on the stick for longer.

props.name: Upper body turns first
props.headline: Upper body turns first
props.detail: The trunk reaches top speed {absValue} {unit} before the hips (target {target}). Let the hips turn first, then the trunk, then the stick.

props.name: Leaning forward
props.headline: Leaning forward
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward (target {target}). Stand tall with the head up and arms out at the sides.

props.name: Short push
props.headline: Short push
props.detail: The pushing leg reaches {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push sideways with the whole blade until the leg is long, then bring it back in.

props.name: Straight skating knee
props.headline: Straight skating knee
props.detail: The skating knee bends {value} {unit} (target {target}). Bend the skating knee so you have something to push from.

props.name: Uneven rhythm
props.headline: Uneven rhythm
props.detail: The time between pushes varies by {value} (target {target}). Push, glide, push, glide at an even beat.

props.name: Skating-knee bend
props.headline: Skating-knee bend
props.detail: The skating knee bends {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep a soft, slightly bent knee.

props.name: Leaning to the side
props.headline: Leaning to the side
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} sideways (target {target}). Stack the shoulders over the hips and the hips over the skating foot.

props.name: Short glide
props.headline: Short glide
props.detail: You glide on one foot for {value} {unit}. The level 4 standard is a 3-second glide; your coach assesses the badge.

props.name: Take-off leg not straightened
props.headline: Take-off leg not straightened
props.detail: The take-off knee reaches {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push all the way through the take-off leg to straight.

props.name: Free foot touches down
props.headline: Free foot touches down
props.detail: The free foot touches down {value} time(s) after landing. Hold the landing position: free leg back, arms out, glide out on one foot.

props.name: Short time in the air
props.headline: Short time in the air
props.detail: You are in the air for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Bend the knee on the entry edge and spring up as the free leg swings through.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: The landing knee bends {value} {unit} (target {target}). Land on the toe then blade with a soft, bending knee.

props.name: Breakdown timing
props.headline: Breakdown timing
props.detail: You settle {value} {unit} before the pull (target {target}). Chop your feet as the carrier comes in, then pull.

props.name: Contact on the pull
props.headline: Contact on the pull
props.detail: You made body contact {value} time(s). Keep your body out of the carrier's path and reach only for the flag.

props.name: Too upright
props.headline: Too upright
props.detail: Your knees bend only {value} {unit} as you pull (target {target}). Sink your hips so you can move either way and reach the hip.

props.name: Arm slot
props.headline: Arm slot
props.detail: Your throwing arm is {value} {unit} from the trunk as the front foot lands (target {target}). Get the elbow up to about shoulder height before you throw.

props.name: Over the pass clock
props.headline: Over the pass clock
props.detail: Your slowest pass left your hand {value} {unit} after the snap, over the 7-second limit. Read your first option quickly and get the ball out.

props.name: Trunk tilt
props.headline: Trunk tilt
props.detail: Your trunk tilts {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Stay tall and tilt only slightly away from the throwing arm.

props.name: Front leg at release
props.headline: Front leg at release
props.detail: Your front knee is bent {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Step to the target and let the front knee flex and brace as you throw.

props.name: Knee moves inward at the break
props.headline: Knee moves inward at the break
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot as you plant (target {target}). Aim to keep the knee over the middle toes.

props.name: Leaning away from the cut
props.headline: Leaning away from the cut
props.detail: Your trunk leans {value} {unit} away from where you are going (target {target}). Keep your chest over the plant foot.

props.name: Slow break
props.headline: Slow break
props.detail: Your plant foot stays down {value} {unit} (target {target}). Plant and push off in one quick step.

props.name: Upright at the break
props.headline: Upright at the break
props.detail: Your plant knee bends only {value} {unit} (target {target}). Sink the hips and lower your centre before you cut.

props.name: High finish
props.headline: High finish
props.detail: Your blade finishes at {value} of your height (target {target}). Follow through low towards your partner.

props.name: Stick above the waist
props.headline: Stick above the waist
props.detail: Your blade went above your waist on {value} pass(es). Keep the sweep and follow-through low.

props.name: Body position
props.headline: Body position
props.detail: Your knees bend {value} {unit} as you pass (target {target}). Bend the knees and get your body over the ball.

props.name: Head down
props.headline: Head down
props.detail: Your head tilts {value} {unit} down as you dribble (target {target}). Feel the ball on the blade and look up between touches.

props.name: Ball played too high
props.headline: Ball played too high
props.detail: You played the ball above knee height {value} time(s). Keep the ball and the blade low.

props.name: Ball too far away
props.headline: Ball too far away
props.detail: The ball's distance from you varies by {value} of your height (target {target}). Use small, soft touches to keep it close.

props.name: Posture
props.headline: Posture
props.detail: Your knees bend {value} {unit} (target {target}). Stay low and balanced over the ball.

props.name: Stick above the waist
props.headline: Stick above the waist
props.detail: Your blade went above your waist on {value} shot(s), which is a free hit and a risk to others. Keep the backswing and follow-through low.

props.name: Turn the body
props.headline: Turn the body
props.detail: Your trunk turns {value} {unit} away from the target in the load (target {target}). Turn the shoulders away, then rotate through the shot.

props.name: Weight transfer
props.headline: Weight transfer
props.detail: Your hips move {value} of your height towards the target (target {target}). Shift your weight from the back leg onto the front leg.

props.name: Supporting leg
props.headline: Supporting leg
props.detail: Your front knee is bent {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Bend the front leg and push through it as you shoot.

props.name: Dropping the hips before diving
props.headline: Dropping the hips before diving
props.detail: The hips drop {value} body-heights before the push-off (target {target}). A big dip adds time before the dive starts.

props.name: Body not behind the line of the ball
props.headline: Body not behind the line of the ball
props.detail: The trunk is {value} {unit} off the line to the ball at contact (target {target}).

props.name: Diving back towards the goal
props.headline: Diving back towards the goal
props.detail: The push-off goes {absValue} {unit} back from the goal line. Attack the ball sideways or slightly forward.

props.name: Set position too narrow
props.headline: Set position too narrow
props.detail: The feet are only {value} leg-lengths apart (target {target}); a slightly wider base gives a stronger push.

props.name: Set position too wide
props.headline: Set position too wide
props.detail: The feet are {value} leg-lengths apart in the set position (target {target}), which slows the first step.

props.name: Knee moves inward as the foot plants
props.headline: Knee moves inward as the foot plants
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot at plant (target {target}). Aim to keep the knee over the middle toes as you cut.

props.name: One side differs from the other
props.headline: One side differs from the other
props.detail: Knee alignment differs by {value} {unit} between left and right cuts (target {target}).

props.name: Long contact on the planted foot
props.headline: Long contact on the planted foot
props.detail: The planted foot stays down {value} {unit} (target {target}).

props.name: Planted leg stays straight
props.headline: Planted leg stays straight
props.detail: The planted knee bends only {value} {unit} (target {target}). Sink into the plant with a softer knee.

props.name: Trunk leans away from the new direction
props.headline: Trunk leans away from the new direction
props.detail: The chest leans {value} {unit} away from where you are going (target {target}). Keep the chest over the planted foot.

props.name: Kicking foot not square to the target
props.headline: Kicking foot not square to the target
props.detail: The kicking foot is turned {value} {unit} relative to the target line at contact (target {target}); present the inside of the foot square to the target.

props.name: Pass direction varies
props.headline: Pass direction varies
props.detail: The follow-through direction varies by {value} {unit} across passes (target {target}).

props.name: Leaning away from the ball
props.headline: Leaning away from the ball
props.detail: The trunk leans back {absValue} {unit} at contact, which can lift the pass off the ground.

props.name: Support foot not pointing at the target
props.headline: Support foot not pointing at the target
props.detail: The support foot points {value} {unit} away from the target line (target {target}), which pulls the pass off line.

props.name: Throwing with the arms only
props.headline: Throwing with the arms only
props.detail: The trunk drives forward only {value} {unit} into the throw (target {target}); use the back and hips for distance.

props.name: A foot leaves the ground at release
props.headline: A foot leaves the ground at release
props.detail: One foot is {value} body-heights off the ground as the ball is released. Both feet must stay on the ground for a legal throw-in.

props.name: Ball not taken behind the head
props.headline: Ball not taken behind the head
props.detail: The ball does not go behind the head before the throw. A legal throw-in starts from behind and over the head.

props.name: Release angle limits distance
props.headline: Release angle limits distance
props.detail: The ball leaves at {value} {unit} (target {target}).

props.name: Ball released below head height
props.headline: Ball released below head height
props.detail: The ball leaves the hands {absValue} body-heights below the top of the head. Release it over the head.

props.name: Follow-through drifts off target
props.headline: Follow-through drifts off target
props.detail: The kicking foot finishes {value} {unit} away from the target line (target {target}).

props.name: Leaning back at contact
props.headline: Leaning back at contact
props.detail: The trunk leans back {value} {unit} as the foot meets the ball (target {target}). Leaning back tends to lift the shot over the bar; keep the chest over the ball.

props.name: Little hip-shoulder wind-up
props.headline: Little hip-shoulder wind-up
props.detail: Hips and shoulders separate by {value} {unit} at plant (target {target}), which limits power.

props.name: Support foot planted too far from the ball
props.headline: Support foot planted too far from the ball
props.detail: The support foot lands {value} body-heights to the side of the ball (target {target}), so the kicking leg has to reach.

props.name: Support leg stays straight
props.headline: Support leg stays straight
props.detail: The support knee bends only {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). A softer support knee helps balance and keeps the shot low.

props.name: Long ball drop
props.headline: Long ball drop
props.detail: The ball falls for {value} {unit} before contact (target {target}). Guide it down and drop it from closer to the foot.

props.name: Short follow-through
props.headline: Short follow-through
props.detail: Your kicking leg is bent {value} {unit} at the top of the follow-through (target {target}). Kick through the ball and finish towards the target.

props.name: Soft support leg
props.headline: Soft support leg
props.detail: Your support knee is bent {value} {unit} as the foot lands (target {target}). Plant a firmer support leg beside the ball's drop line.

props.name: Support knee at contact
props.headline: Support knee at contact
props.detail: Your support knee is bent {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Stay balanced over the support foot as you strike.

props.name: Two bounces in a row
props.headline: Two bounces in a row
props.detail: You bounced twice in a row {value} time(s). Alternate a bounce with a solo.

props.name: Head down
props.headline: Head down
props.detail: Your head tilts {value} {unit} down while soloing (target {target}). Feel the ball off the foot and lift your eyes to the play.

props.name: Too many steps
props.headline: Too many steps
props.detail: You carried the ball more than four steps without playing it {value} time(s). Solo or bounce within four steps.

props.name: Uneven solo rhythm
props.headline: Uneven solo rhythm
props.detail: Your steps between solos vary by {value} (target {target}). Drop the ball onto the same foot at a steady rhythm.

props.name: Contact point
props.headline: Contact point
props.detail: You strike the sliotar {value} of your height from knee height (target {target}). Let it drop and strike it at about knee height.

props.name: Helmet missing
props.headline: Helmet missing
props.detail: No helmet was seen in {value} clip(s). A helmet with a face guard is required whenever you hurl or play camogie, including practice.

props.name: Weight transfer
props.headline: Weight transfer
props.detail: Your hips move {value} of your height towards the target (target {target}). Step forward with the lead foot and finish with your weight on the front leg.

props.name: Toss height
props.headline: Toss height
props.detail: Your toss peaks {value} of your height from shoulder level (target {target}). Toss from a cupped hand to about shoulder height, just in front of you.

props.name: High ball
props.headline: High ball
props.detail: {value} throw(s) did not touch the floor by the high ball line, which gives a penalty. Release low, close to the floor.

props.name: Speed varies
props.headline: Speed varies
props.detail: Your ball time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same steps and swing every throw.

props.name: Long ball
props.headline: Long ball
props.detail: {value} throw(s) did not touch the neutral area, which gives a penalty. Keep the ball low so it rolls or bounces through the middle of the court.

props.name: Ball speed
props.headline: Ball speed
props.detail: Your throws take {value} {unit} to reach the goal line (target {target}). Faster balls give defenders less time; build speed through the run-up and swing.

props.name: Out of your area
props.headline: Out of your area
props.detail: On {value} throw(s) your first contact came with no part of you in your Team Area. Use the lines to set your position before each throw.

props.name: Slow to react
props.headline: Slow to react
props.detail: You start moving {value} {unit} after the release (target {target}). Stay balanced and listen for the bells from the moment the thrower picks up the ball.

props.name: Reactions vary
props.headline: Reactions vary
props.detail: Your reaction time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same ready position every throw.

props.name: Touched eyeshades
props.headline: Touched eyeshades
props.detail: You touched your eyeshades {value} time(s) during play, which is a penalty. Ask the referee if they need adjusting.

props.name: Slow to throw
props.headline: Slow to throw
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} from first contact to release (target {target}). Find the lines quickly by touch and set your feet.

props.name: Ten seconds
props.headline: Ten seconds
props.detail: Your longest sequence took {value} {unit} from first contact to the ball crossing the centre line (limit {target}). Agree a quick routine for who throws next.

props.name: Standing up through impact
props.headline: Standing up through impact
props.detail: The forward bend reduces by {value} {unit} from address to impact (target {target}). Keep the chest over the ball as you turn through.

props.name: Head moves sideways
props.headline: Head moves sideways
props.detail: The head moves {value} body-heights sideways before impact (target {target}). Turn around a steady centre.

props.name: Hips turn as far as the shoulders
props.headline: Hips turn as far as the shoulders
props.detail: The hips turn {value} {unit} by the top (target {target}). Let the shoulders turn further than the hips.

props.name: Posture at address
props.headline: Posture at address
props.detail: The trunk bends {value} {unit} forward at address (target {target}). Hinge from the hips so the arms hang under the shoulders.

props.name: Short shoulder turn
props.headline: Short shoulder turn
props.detail: The shoulders turn {value} {unit} by the top (target {target}). Turn the back towards the target as far as is comfortable.

props.name: Little shoulder-hip separation
props.headline: Little shoulder-hip separation
props.detail: The shoulders are only {value} {unit} ahead of the hips at the top (target {target}). Turn the shoulders more than the hips in the backswing.

props.name: Swing tempo
props.headline: Swing tempo
props.detail: The backswing takes {value} times as long as the downswing (target {target}). Use a smooth, even count back and through.

props.name: Possible anchored stroke
props.headline: Possible anchored stroke
props.detail: The putter grip, a hand or a forearm looks held against the body during the stroke. Rule 10.1b does not allow anchoring; just touching your clothing is fine. A referee makes the final call.

props.name: Backstroke timing
props.headline: Backstroke timing
props.detail: The backstroke takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep the same unhurried backstroke for every putt.

props.name: Forward stroke timing
props.headline: Forward stroke timing
props.detail: The forward stroke takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Let the putter swing through at an even pace.

props.name: Head moves during the stroke
props.headline: Head moves during the stroke
props.detail: The head moves {value} body-heights before the ball is on its way (target {target}). Keep the eyes on the spot until after impact.

props.name: Stroke rhythm
props.headline: Stroke rhythm
props.detail: The backstroke takes {value} times as long as the forward stroke (target {target}). Aim for a back-and-through rhythm of about two to one.

props.name: Clubhead passes the hands at impact
props.headline: Clubhead passes the hands at impact
props.detail: The clubhead is {absValue} body-heights ahead of the hands at impact (target {target}). Keep the hands level with or ahead of the clubhead through the ball.

props.name: Head moves sideways
props.headline: Head moves sideways
props.detail: The head moves {value} body-heights sideways before impact (target {target}). Keep a steady centre for short shots.

props.name: Set-up leans away from the target
props.headline: Set-up leans away from the target
props.detail: The hips sit {absValue} body-heights behind the middle of the stance (target {target}). Set more pressure on the lead foot at address.

props.name: Wide stance for a chip
props.headline: Wide stance for a chip
props.detail: The feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}). Narrow the stance for a short swing.

props.name: Bent knees
props.headline: Bent knees
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at the top (target {target}). Keep the legs long and point the toes.

props.name: Hips pass to the side
props.headline: Hips pass to the side
props.detail: The hips are {value} body-heights off the line of the hands at the top (target {target}). Put the hands down on the line and lift the hips right over them.

props.name: Legs close together at the top
props.headline: Legs close together at the top
props.detail: The legs are split {value} {unit} over the hands (target {target}). Kick the back leg up and reach wide with both legs, like a star.

props.name: Arms bend
props.headline: Arms bend
props.detail: The elbows are at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep the arms long and straight.

props.name: Shoulders not fully open
props.headline: Shoulders not fully open
props.detail: The angle between the arms and the body is {value} {unit} (target {target}). Reach the arms up by the ears and push the floor away.

props.name: Body leans off vertical
props.headline: Body leans off vertical
props.detail: The body line tilts {value} {unit} from vertical (target {target}). Stack the hips over the shoulders and the shoulders over the hands.

props.name: Bend at the hips
props.headline: Bend at the hips
props.detail: The hip line is at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Squeeze the legs together and keep one straight line from hands to toes.

props.name: Short hold
props.headline: Short hold
props.detail: You hold still for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push tall through the shoulders and make small corrections with the fingers and wrists.

props.name: Steps after landing
props.headline: Steps after landing
props.detail: You take {value} step(s) after landing. Land with the feet hip-width apart, arms forward, and hold still.

props.name: Knees move inward on landing
props.headline: Knees move inward on landing
props.detail: The knees drift {value} {unit} inside the line of the feet (target {target}). Land with the knees over the toes.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Land on the balls of the feet and bend the ankles, knees and hips together.

props.name: Hands low in the ready position
props.headline: Hands low in the ready position
props.detail: The hands are {absValue} body-heights below the shoulders when ready (target {target}). Hold the hands up around shoulder height.

props.name: Ready-position knee bend
props.headline: Ready-position knee bend
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} in the ready position (target {target}). Stand with soft knees, weight on the balls of the feet.

props.name: Late first movement
