props.headline: Late first movement
props.detail: You start to move {value} {unit} after the release (target {target}). Watch the ball in the shooter's hand and move as it leaves.

props.name: Short arm at release
props.headline: Short arm at release
props.detail: The elbow is at {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Lead with the elbow, then extend the arm through the throw.

props.name: Little trunk action
props.headline: Little trunk action
props.detail: The trunk tilts forward {value} {unit} into the release (target {target}). Arch back in the air, then snap the trunk forward as you throw.

props.name: Low release
props.headline: Low release
props.detail: The hand is at {value} times your height at release (target {target}). Drive the free knee up at take-off and release at the top of the jump.

props.name: Take-off on or inside the goal-area line
props.headline: Take-off on or inside the goal-area line
props.detail: You take off from on or inside the 6 m line {value} time(s). Take off outside the line; you may land inside after releasing the ball.

props.name: Too many steps
props.headline: Too many steps
props.detail: You take {value} steps with the ball before take-off. The rules allow 3. In a match the referees decide.

props.name: Hips and shoulders turn together
props.headline: Hips and shoulders turn together
props.detail: The hips lead the shoulders by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Plant the front foot, turn the hips first, then let the shoulders and arm follow.

props.name: Low throwing elbow
props.headline: Low throwing elbow
props.detail: The throwing elbow is {absValue} body-heights below the shoulder at arm cocking (target {target}). Lift the elbow to shoulder height before you throw.

props.name: Short last stride
props.headline: Short last stride
props.detail: The last stride is {value} times your height (target {target}). Make the last stride long to brace before the throw.

props.name: Too many steps
props.headline: Too many steps
props.detail: You take {value} steps with the ball before releasing it. The rules allow 3. In a match the referees decide.

props.name: Little trunk turn
props.headline: Little trunk turn
props.detail: The trunk turns {value} {unit} away from the target before the shot (target {target}). Turn the shoulders away, then rotate through towards the net.

props.name: Little weight transfer
props.headline: Little weight transfer
props.detail: The hips move {value} body-heights towards the target during the shot (target {target}). Shift from the back leg onto the front leg as you shoot.

props.name: Slow release
props.headline: Slow release
props.detail: The shot takes {value} {unit} from load to release (target {target}). Pull the puck in and release it in one quick motion.

props.name: Push goes back, not out
props.headline: Push goes back, not out
props.detail: The push leg moves {value} {unit} out to the side (target {target}). Push the skate out to the side with the full blade.

props.name: Push leg not fully extended
props.headline: Push leg not fully extended
props.detail: The push knee is at {value} {unit} as the skate lifts off (target {target}). Finish each push through the toe with a long leg.

props.name: Skating tall
props.headline: Skating tall
props.detail: The knee bends only {value} {unit} as the skate lands (target {target}). Sit lower with the knees over the toes.

props.name: Slow first strides
props.headline: Slow first strides
props.detail: Each stride takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use short, quick, powerful pushes in the first strides.

props.name: Upright in the start
props.headline: Upright in the start
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward in the first strides (target {target}). Lean forward and drive.

props.name: Trunk leans in the stop
props.headline: Trunk leans in the stop
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} during the stop (target {target}). Keep the chest up and the shoulders level.

props.name: Long stop
props.headline: Long stop
props.detail: The stop takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Turn the hips quickly and dig both edges in.

props.name: Stopping with straight legs
props.headline: Stopping with straight legs
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} in the stop (target {target}). Sit down into the stop with both knees bent.

props.name: Standing up while moving
props.headline: Standing up while moving
props.detail: Your hips rise and fall {value} of your height as you shuffle (target {target}). Stay low through every step.

props.name: Hands position
props.headline: Hands position
props.detail: Your hands sit {value} of your height from hip level (target {target}). Keep the hands up and out in front, ready.

props.name: Stance height
props.headline: Stance height
props.detail: Your knees are bent {value} {unit} in the stance (target {target}). Sit into a low, balanced ready position you can move from.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: Your feet are {value} of your height apart (target {target}). Set them a little wider than your shoulders.

props.name: Baulk line not crossed
props.headline: Baulk line not crossed
props.detail: {value} raid(s) did not cross the baulk line. Get a foot over the baulk line on every raid.

props.name: Bonus would not count
props.headline: Bonus would not count
props.detail: Your trailing foot was on the ground {value} time(s) as you crossed the bonus line. Lift the trailing foot as the leading foot reaches over.

props.name: Off balance on the bonus
props.headline: Off balance on the bonus
props.detail: You lean {value} {unit} towards the end line at the bonus (target {target}). Keep your weight over the trailing leg so you can push back fast.

props.name: Raid too long
props.headline: Raid too long
props.detail: Your longest raid took {value} {unit}, over the 30-second limit. Plan your route and head back in time.

props.name: Bent reaching leg
props.headline: Bent reaching leg
props.detail: Your leading knee is at {value} {unit} at full reach (target {target}). Extend the leg fully to cover more distance.

props.name: Point the toe
props.headline: Point the toe
props.detail: Your leading ankle is at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Point the foot and touch with the inner edge of the toes.

props.name: Short reach
props.headline: Short reach
props.detail: Your feet are {value} of your height apart at full reach (target {target}). Sink lower on the trailing leg and reach further.

props.name: Slow recovery
props.headline: Slow recovery
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} to get back to a balanced stance (target {target}). Snap the leg back under you straight after the touch.

props.name: Call after the touch
props.headline: Call after the touch
props.detail: The kho was called before the touch {value} time(s), which is a foul. Touch the back and call together.

props.name: Rose too early
props.headline: Rose too early
props.detail: The receiver left the square before the kho touch {value} time(s), which is a foul. Wait for the touch, then explode out.

props.name: Slow to rise
props.headline: Slow to rise
props.detail: The receiver takes {value} {unit} to move after the touch (target {target}). Sit ready on the balls of the feet, eyes on the runner.

props.name: Crossed the central lane
props.headline: Crossed the central lane
props.detail: You crossed the central lane {value} time(s) before reaching the free zone, which is a foul. Stay in your half until you turn at the pole.

props.name: Slow turn
props.headline: Slow turn
props.detail: Your turn takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Shorten the steps into the turn and push out of it.

props.name: Wide turn
props.headline: Wide turn
props.detail: You pass {value} {unit} from the pole (target {target}). Run a tighter line round the pole.

props.name: Slow cut
props.headline: Slow cut
props.detail: Your cutting foot stays down {value} {unit} (target {target}). Lower the hips before the cut and push off quickly.

props.name: Top speed
props.headline: Top speed
props.detail: Your top speed is {value} {unit} (target {target}). Short sprints with full recovery build speed.

props.name: Losing speed
props.headline: Losing speed
props.detail: You keep {value} of your speed through the dodge (target {target}). Turn the head and shoulders first, then drive out.

props.name: Pivot foot moving
props.headline: Pivot foot moving
props.detail: Your pivot foot slides {value} of your height (target {target}). Keep the pivot foot planted and turn on the ball of the foot.

props.name: Slow ball
props.headline: Slow ball
props.detail: You hold the ball {value} {unit} before passing (target {target}). Look up as you catch and move the ball on.

props.name: Running with the ball
props.headline: Running with the ball
props.detail: On {value} catch(es) you still held the ball after the third foot landed. Stop in two steps or pass on the second.

props.name: Upright stop
props.headline: Upright stop
props.detail: Your knees bend only {value} {unit} as you stop (target {target}). Sink low to stop quickly and stay balanced.

props.name: Shot arc
props.headline: Shot arc
props.detail: Your shots leave at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push up through the ball so it drops into the korf from above.

props.name: Inconsistent arc
props.headline: Inconsistent arc
props.detail: Your launch angle varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Set your feet for balance and use the same action every shot.

props.name: Low release
props.headline: Low release
props.detail: You release at {value} times your height (target {target}). Extend the arms fully above your head so the shot is harder to block.

props.name: Leg drive
props.headline: Leg drive
props.detail: Your knees bend {value} {unit} at the dip (target {target}). Bend the knees and drive up from the floor so the power comes from your legs.

props.name: Low release
props.headline: Low release
props.detail: Your hand is {value} of your height above your head at release (target {target}). Reach up and lay the ball into the korf.

props.name: Release timing
props.headline: Release timing
props.detail: You release {value} {unit} after take-off (target {target}). Release near the top of the jump.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: Your knees bend only {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Land on both feet with soft knees and keep clear of the post.

props.name: Running with the ball
props.headline: Running with the ball
props.detail: On {value} run-in(s) you still held the ball after the third foot landed. Catch on the move, take one step and go up.

props.name: Head not over the ball
props.headline: Head not over the ball
props.detail: The head is {value} body-heights from the front foot at the pick-up (target {target}). Get the head and chest over the ball as you scoop.

props.name: Reaching instead of getting low
props.headline: Reaching instead of getting low
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at the pick-up (target {target}). Bend the knees and get the bottom hand low, rather than reaching down from the waist.

props.name: Slow to protect the ball
props.headline: Slow to protect the ball
props.detail: It takes {value} {unit} to bring the stick up after the scoop (target {target}). Scoop through and bring the stick up by your ear.

props.name: Stepped on or over the crease
props.headline: Stepped on or over the crease
props.detail: You step on or over the crease line {value} time(s) while shooting. Shoot from outside the line. In a match the officials decide.

props.name: Hips and shoulders turn together
props.headline: Hips and shoulders turn together
props.detail: The hips lead the shoulders by {value} {unit} at the plant (target {target}). Turn the shoulders away from the goal, step, then let the hips pull the shoulders and stick through.

props.name: Front foot open
props.headline: Front foot open
props.detail: The front foot points {value} {unit} away from the target (target {target}). Step with the front foot pointing at the goal.

props.name: Short step
props.headline: Short step
props.detail: The last stride is {value} times your height (target {target}). Step down towards the goal as you shoot.

props.name: Top hand low
props.headline: Top hand low
props.detail: The top hand is {absValue} body-heights below the shoulder with the stick back (target {target}). Bring the top hand up by your ear before you pass.

props.name: Little step into the pass
props.headline: Little step into the pass
props.detail: The step is {value} times your height (target {target}). Step towards your target with the opposite foot.

props.name: Stick drops to the side
props.headline: Stick drops to the side
props.detail: The stick tilts {value} {unit} from vertical at release (target {target}). Keep the stick up and pass over the top for accuracy.

props.name: Landing foot put back down
props.headline: Landing foot put back down
props.detail: The landing foot goes back down {value} time(s) before the pass. Once you lift it, pass before it touches the ground again. In a match the umpire decides.

props.name: Held the ball too long
props.headline: Held the ball too long
props.detail: You pass {value} {unit} after the catch. The rules allow 3 seconds. In a match the umpire decides.

props.name: Knee moves inward on landing
props.headline: Knee moves inward on landing
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot as you land (target {target}). Land with the knee in line with the foot.

props.name: Landing with a stiff leg
props.headline: Landing with a stiff leg
props.detail: The landing knee bends only {value} {unit} (target {target}). Land softly: bend the hips and knee and roll through the foot.

props.name: Trunk tilts on landing
props.headline: Trunk tilts on landing
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} to the side as you land (target {target}). Keep the chest up and centred over the landing foot.

props.name: Held the ball too long
props.headline: Held the ball too long
props.detail: You pass {value} {unit} after the catch. The rules allow 3 seconds. In a match the umpire decides.

props.name: Little step into the pass
props.headline: Little step into the pass
props.detail: The step is {value} times your height (target {target}). Step towards your target as you pass.

props.name: Release height
props.headline: Release height
props.detail: The hands are at {value} body-heights from shoulder level at release (target {target}). Push the ball from chest height so it travels flat.

props.name: Arms not fully extended
props.headline: Arms not fully extended
props.detail: The elbows are at {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Push both arms out towards the target and finish with the thumbs pointing down.

props.name: Flat shot
props.headline: Flat shot
props.detail: The ball leaves the hand at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Aim higher so the ball drops down into the ring.

props.name: Held the ball too long
props.headline: Held the ball too long
props.detail: You shoot {value} {unit} after the catch. The rules allow 3 seconds. In a match the umpire decides.

props.name: Knee bend before the shot
props.headline: Knee bend before the shot
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} before the shot (target {target}). Bend the knees smoothly, then straighten them as the arm extends.

props.name: Arm not fully extended
props.headline: Arm not fully extended
props.detail: The elbow is at {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Reach up towards the ring and finish with a high arm.

props.name: Body moves during the shot
props.headline: Body moves during the shot
props.detail: The trunk moves {value} {unit} during the shot (target {target}). Stay tall and still; let the legs and arm do the work.

props.name: Boat turning
props.headline: Boat turning
props.detail: The boat turns {value} {unit} per stroke (target {target}). Finish each stroke with a small J, thumb down, to hold the line.

props.name: Paddle angled out
props.headline: Paddle angled out
props.detail: Your shaft leans {value} {unit} from vertical at the catch (target {target}). Stack the top hand over the bottom hand.

props.name: Uneven rhythm
props.headline: Uneven rhythm
props.detail: Your stroke time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep a steady, unhurried rhythm.

props.name: Arms only
props.headline: Arms only
props.detail: Your trunk turns {value} {unit} per stroke (target {target}). Wind up the trunk at the catch and unwind as you pull.

props.name: Stroke rate
props.headline: Stroke rate
props.detail: Each stroke takes {value} {unit} at this effort (target {target}). Quicken the hands back to the catch rather than pulling longer.

props.name: Rocking forward and back
props.headline: Rocking forward and back
props.detail: Your trunk rocks {value} {unit} each stroke (target {target}). Sit tall and turn rather than bob.

props.name: Short reach
props.headline: Short reach
props.detail: Your pulling arm reaches {value} {unit} at the catch (target {target}). Reach forward and place the blade near your feet.

props.name: Uneven sides
props.headline: Uneven sides
props.detail: Your left and right strokes differ (ratio {value}, target {target}). Match the timing on both sides.

props.name: Bent lower arm
props.headline: Bent lower arm
props.detail: Your lower elbow is at {value} {unit} at the catch (target {target}). Keep the lower arm long as the blade goes in.

props.name: Reach from the hips
props.headline: Reach from the hips
props.detail: Your hips move through {value} {unit} each stroke (target {target}). Hinge at the hips to reach forward, then stand tall as you pull.

props.name: Stroke rate
props.headline: Stroke rate
props.detail: Each stroke takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Look ahead rather than at the board and keep a steady rhythm.

props.name: Pulling with the arms
props.headline: Pulling with the arms
props.detail: Your shoulder moves through {value} {unit} each stroke (target {target}). Let the hips and trunk do more of the work.

props.name: Swinging at the volley
props.headline: Swinging at the volley
props.detail: The racket travels {value} body-heights into contact (target {target}). Use a short punch with little backswing.

props.name: Volley too close to the body
props.headline: Volley too close to the body
props.detail: The racket meets the ball {value} body-heights in front of the hips (target {target}). Step forward and meet the ball in front.

props.name: Volley base
props.headline: Volley base
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}).

props.name: Racket head drops
props.headline: Racket head drops
props.detail: The racket head is {absValue} body-heights below the wrist at contact (target {target}). Keep the racket head up and the wrist firm.

props.name: Short arm at contact
props.headline: Short arm at contact
props.detail: The elbow is at {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Reach up to the ball with a long arm.

props.name: Ball behind you at contact
props.headline: Ball behind you at contact
props.detail: The racket meets the ball {absValue} body-heights behind the playing shoulder (target {target}). Move your feet so the ball is in front.

props.name: Bandeja contact height
props.headline: Bandeja contact height
props.detail: The racket meets the ball at {value} times your height (target {target}). Turn sideways early and meet the ball just above and in front of the head.

props.name: Falling back during the shot
props.headline: Falling back during the shot
props.detail: The hips move {value} body-heights towards the net (target {target}). Step into the shot and recover forward to the net.

props.name: Ball struck above the waist
props.headline: Ball struck above the waist
props.detail: The ball is about {value} body-heights above the waist at contact. Let it drop and strike it at or below waist height. In a match the referee decides.

props.name: Serve contact point
props.headline: Serve contact point
props.detail: The racket meets the ball {value} body-heights in front of the hips (target {target}). Bounce the ball slightly in front and to the side.

props.name: Both feet off the ground at contact
props.headline: Both feet off the ground at contact
props.detail: Both feet are off the ground when you strike the ball on {value} serve(s). Keep at least one foot on the ground.

props.name: Foot on the line
props.headline: Foot on the line
props.detail: A foot touches the service or centre line {value} time(s). Stand behind the service line and to your side of the centre line.

props.name: Launch angle
props.headline: Launch angle
props.detail: Your discus leaves at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Release at about shoulder height with the discus flat.

props.name: Bent arm at release
props.headline: Bent arm at release
props.detail: Your elbow is at {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Keep the arm long as it sweeps through.

props.name: Launch varies
props.headline: Launch varies
props.detail: Your launch angle varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same wind-back and release point every throw.

props.name: Outside the sector
props.headline: Outside the sector
props.detail: {value} throw(s) landed on or outside the sector lines. Check the frame angle and release towards the middle of the sector.

props.name: Left the seat
props.headline: Left the seat
props.detail: On {value} throw(s) you lost seat contact before the discus landed, which is a foul. Keep the backs of the knees and buttocks on the seat until it lands.

props.name: Distances vary
props.headline: Distances vary
props.detail: Your distances vary by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep the same grip on the bar and the same routine every throw.

props.name: Use the trunk
props.headline: Use the trunk
props.detail: Your trunk moves {value} {unit} from the power position to release (target {target}, set with your coach for your class). Start the throw with the trunk, then the arm.

props.name: Outside the sector
props.headline: Outside the sector
props.detail: {value} throw(s) landed on or outside the sector lines. Check the frame faces the middle of the sector and finish towards it.

props.name: Left the seat
props.headline: Left the seat
props.detail: On {value} throw(s) you lost seat contact before the shot landed, which is a foul. Keep the backs of the knees and buttocks on the seat until it lands; ask your coach about strapping.

props.name: Short finish
props.headline: Short finish
props.detail: Your elbow is at {value} {unit} when the shot leaves (target {target}). Push all the way through the shot.

props.name: Slow push rhythm
props.headline: Slow push rhythm
props.detail: Each push cycle takes {value} {unit} at this pace (target {target}). Work on a quicker hand return to the push rim.

props.name: Sitting tall
props.headline: Sitting tall
props.detail: Your trunk averages {value} {unit} above horizontal (target {target}, adjusted with your coach for your class and chair). Settle lower over the push rim if your set-up allows.

props.name: Trunk movement
props.headline: Trunk movement
props.detail: Your trunk moves through {value} {unit} each push (target {target}, set with your coach for your class). Too much can make speed surge and drop; too little may leave power unused.

props.name: Uneven rhythm
props.headline: Uneven rhythm
props.detail: Your push cycle time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Count a steady rhythm and keep each push the same.

props.name: Stick the landing
props.headline: Stick the landing
props.detail: You took {value} extra step(s) after landing (target {target}). Land with the feet together and hold.

props.name: Off the line
props.headline: Off the line
props.detail: Your feet land {value} {unit} from the target line (target {target}). Fix your eyes on the line and use your arms to drive.

props.name: Absorb the landing
props.headline: Absorb the landing
props.detail: You stop in {value} {unit} (target {target}). Let the legs absorb the landing over a longer time; land quietly.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: Your knees bend {value} {unit} after landing (target {target}). Land on the balls of the feet and sink through ankles, knees and hips.

props.name: Come up sooner
props.headline: Come up sooner
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} to stand after the roll (target {target}). Tuck one leg under and push straight up.

props.name: Smooth it out
props.headline: Smooth it out
props.detail: Your roll takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Stay round and let the momentum carry you.

props.name: Roll diagonally
props.headline: Roll diagonally
props.detail: Your roll was rated {value} for its diagonal path (target {target}). Tuck the head to the side and roll from one shoulder across the back to the opposite hip, not over the spine.

props.name: Heavy hand
props.headline: Heavy hand
props.detail: Your hand stays on the obstacle for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Place and push away quickly.

props.name: Losing speed
props.headline: Losing speed
props.detail: You keep {value} of your speed through the vault (target {target}). Take off a little further back and carry the body over, not up.

props.name: Stutter steps
props.headline: Stutter steps
props.detail: You took {value} stutter step(s) after landing (target {target}). Land running, leading leg first.

props.name: Swinging at the dink
props.headline: Swinging at the dink
props.detail: The paddle travels {value} body-heights into each dink (target {target}). Use a short, soft lift from the shoulder.

props.name: Contact close to the body
props.headline: Contact close to the body
props.detail: The paddle meets the ball {value} body-heights in front of the hips (target {target}). Meet the ball out in front.

props.name: Standing tall to dink
props.headline: Standing tall to dink
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Bend the knees and stay low rather than reaching with the arm.

props.name: Volley from inside the kitchen
props.headline: Volley from inside the kitchen
props.detail: You volley the ball {value} time(s) while standing in or on the non-volley zone. Step back behind the line to volley, or let the ball bounce first. In a match the referee decides.

props.name: Swing too big
props.headline: Swing too big
props.detail: The paddle travels {value} body-heights into contact (target {target}). Use a shorter, smoother swing from low to high.

props.name: Contact too high
props.headline: Contact too high
props.detail: The ball is {value} body-heights below the waist at contact (target {target}). Let it drop lower and lift it.

props.name: Drop launch angle
props.headline: Drop launch angle
props.detail: The ball leaves at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Lift the ball on a gentle arc that peaks before the net and lands in the kitchen.

props.name: Standing tall
props.headline: Standing tall
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Bend the knees and lift with the legs.

props.name: Swinging at the volley
props.headline: Swinging at the volley
props.detail: The paddle travels {value} body-heights into the volley (target {target}). Use a short punch or block.

props.name: Volley too close to the body
props.headline: Volley too close to the body
props.detail: The paddle meets the ball {value} body-heights in front of the hips (target {target}). Keep the paddle up and out in front.

props.name: Stepping into the kitchen after volleying
props.headline: Stepping into the kitchen after volleying
props.detail: After volleying you touch the non-volley zone or its line {value} time(s). Stay balanced behind the line after the volley. In a match the referee decides.

props.name: Paddle not moving upward at contact
props.headline: Paddle not moving upward at contact
props.detail: The paddle hand is moving level or downward at contact. A volley serve needs an upward arc.

props.name: Contact looks above the navel
props.headline: Contact looks above the navel
props.detail: At contact the ball is {absValue} body-heights above the navel line. A volley serve must be struck below the navel.

props.name: Front foot on or over the baseline
props.headline: Front foot on or over the baseline
props.detail: The front toe is on or inside the baseline at contact.

props.name: Contact height varies from serve to serve
props.headline: Contact height varies from serve to serve
props.detail: Contact height spreads by {value} body-heights across serves (target {target}).

props.name: Little forward weight shift
props.headline: Little forward weight shift
props.detail: The hips move {value} body-heights forward into contact (target {target}).

props.name: Paddle head above the wrist at contact
props.headline: Paddle head above the wrist at contact
props.detail: The paddle head is above the wrist at contact. Keep the paddle tip pointing down through the strike.

props.name: Carried over the line
props.headline: Carried over the line
props.detail: You carried the ring over a blue line {value} time(s). Pass it across the line to a teammate before you reach it.

props.name: Pass accuracy
props.headline: Pass accuracy
props.detail: Your passes arrive {value} {unit} from the receiver's stick (target {target}). Release in front of your body and follow through to the target.

props.name: Move it on
props.headline: Move it on
props.detail: You hold the ring for {value} {unit} before passing (target {target}). Look for your pass before the ring arrives.

props.name: Two-line pass
props.headline: Two-line pass
props.detail: {value} pass(es) crossed both blue lines, which gives the ring away. Pass to a teammate in the middle zone first.

props.name: In the crease
props.headline: In the crease
props.detail: You entered the goal crease on {value} shot(s). Shoot from outside the red semicircle.

props.name: Quick release
props.headline: Quick release
props.detail: Your shot takes {value} {unit} from load to release (target {target}). Shorten the backswing and release in front of the body.

props.name: Shot speed
props.headline: Shot speed
props.detail: Your shot leaves at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Shift your body over the front foot and snap the stick through.

props.name: Finish the push
props.headline: Finish the push
props.detail: Your knee reaches {value} {unit} at push-off (target {target}). Push out to the side until the leg is nearly straight.

props.name: Trunk position
props.headline: Trunk position
props.detail: Your trunk is at {value} {unit} above horizontal (target {target}). Lean forward from the hips, chest up.

props.name: Uneven strides
props.headline: Uneven strides
props.detail: Your stride time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Find an even rhythm on both legs.

props.name: Bend the knees
props.headline: Bend the knees
props.detail: Your knee is at {value} {unit} as the skate lands (target {target}). Sit lower with knees bent and head up.

props.name: Bat not level
props.headline: Bat not level
props.detail: Your bat is {value} {unit} from level at contact (target {target}). Swing through the line of the ball on a flatter path.

props.name: More body turn
props.headline: More body turn
props.detail: Your shoulders turn {value} {unit} through the hit (target {target}). Start side-on and turn your chest towards the field as you swing.

props.name: Foot over the line
props.headline: Foot over the line
props.detail: A foot crossed the batting square line before the hit {value} time(s), which would be out. Take a shorter step and keep both feet inside the square until you hit.

props.name: Step to the ball
props.headline: Step to the ball
props.detail: Your step is {value} of your height (target {target}). Take a short, controlled step towards the bowler as you swing.

props.name: Foot out of the square
props.headline: Foot out of the square
props.detail: A foot left the bowling square on {value} ball(s), which is a no-ball. Start further back in the square and step forward inside it.

props.name: Ball outside knee-to-head
props.headline: Ball outside knee-to-head
props.detail: {value} ball(s) passed above the batter's head or below the knee. Aim for the space between the batter's shoulder and knee.

props.name: Release varies
props.headline: Release varies
props.detail: Your release height varies by {value} of your height (target {target}). Use the same swing and step for every ball.

props.name: Release point
props.headline: Release point
props.detail: You release {value} of your height from hip level (target {target}). Swing the arm low and back, then release at about waist height.

props.name: Turn the body
props.headline: Turn the body
props.detail: Your shoulders turn {value} {unit} (target {target}). Turn side-on, then rotate your chest to the target as you throw.

props.name: Low elbow
props.headline: Low elbow
props.detail: Your elbow sits {value} of your height below the shoulder as you step (target {target}). Lift the elbow to shoulder height and throw over the top.

props.name: Step into the throw
props.headline: Step into the throw
props.detail: Your step is {value} of your height (target {target}). Step towards the post with the opposite foot as you throw.

props.name: Back opens early
props.headline: Back opens early
props.detail: Only {value}% of the leg drive is done when the back starts to swing (target {target}). Push with the legs first, then swing the body, then pull with the arms.

props.name: Arms bent at the catch
props.headline: Arms bent at the catch
props.detail: The elbows are at {value} {unit} at the catch (target {target}). Keep the arms long and loose; let the legs start the stroke.

props.name: Body angle at the catch
props.headline: Body angle at the catch
props.detail: The body leans {value} {unit} forward at the catch (target {target}). Rock over from the hips with a tall back before the knees bend.

props.name: Catch length
props.headline: Catch length
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at the catch (target {target}). Come forward until the shins are about vertical, no further.

props.name: Finish position
props.headline: Finish position
props.detail: The body is {value} {unit} past vertical at the finish (target {target}). Finish with a slight lean back and a strong core, handle to the lower chest.

props.name: Body swings late
props.headline: Body swings late
props.detail: The body leans {value} {unit} forward when the knees start to bend (target {target}). Rock the body over from the hips before you slide forward.

props.name: Knees bend before the hands pass
props.headline: Knees bend before the hands pass
props.detail: The knees start to bend {absValue} {unit} before the handle clears them. Hands away first, then body over, then let the knees come up.

props.name: Rushing the recovery
props.headline: Rushing the recovery
props.detail: The recovery takes {value} times as long as the drive (target {target}). Drive hard, then come forward slowly and under control.

props.name: Launch angle for distance
props.headline: Launch angle for distance
props.detail: The ball leaves at {value} {unit} (target {target} for long kicks). Adjust where the foot strikes the ball.

props.name: Support foot ahead of or behind the ball
props.headline: Support foot ahead of or behind the ball
props.detail: The support foot is {value} leg lengths from level with the ball (target {target}). Plant it level with or just behind the ball.

props.name: Support foot spacing
props.headline: Support foot spacing
props.detail: The support foot lands {value} leg lengths to the side of the ball (target {target}). Plant it a comfortable hand-span beside the ball.

props.name: Support-knee bend
props.headline: Support-knee bend
props.detail: The support knee bends {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Keep a soft, steady knee over the support foot.

props.name: Slow service
props.headline: Slow service
props.detail: The pass takes {value} {unit} from pick-up to release (target {target}). Sweep the ball straight to the target without a backswing.

props.name: Hips square to the ball
props.headline: Hips square to the ball
props.detail: The hips turn only {value} {unit} towards the target (target {target}). Step the near foot to the ball and point the hips at the target.

props.name: Standing up before passing
props.headline: Standing up before passing
props.detail: The hips are at {value} times your height at pick-up (target {target}). Stay low and sweep the ball off the ground.

props.name: Backswing position
props.headline: Backswing position
props.detail: The arms reach {value} {unit} of shoulder flexion at the top of the backswing (target {target}). Take the ball back to the same point above the head every time.

props.name: Hips rock forward during the throw
props.headline: Hips rock forward during the throw
props.detail: The pelvis rocks {value} {unit} forward as you throw (target {target}). Keep a stable base and let the trunk and arms make the throw.

props.name: Pause in the throw
props.headline: Pause in the throw
props.detail: The throw takes {value} {unit} from the backswing to release (target {target}). Go straight from the backswing into the throw.

props.name: Arm touch
props.headline: Arm touch
props.detail: The ball touched your hand or arm {value} time(s), which is a fault. Keep the arms out wide for balance.

props.name: Keep-up count
props.headline: Keep-up count
props.detail: Your best run was {value} touches (target {target}). Turn the inside of the foot flat to the ball and lift it to knee height.

props.name: Uneven height
props.headline: Uneven height
props.detail: The ball height varies by {value} {unit} between touches (target {target}). Use a soft, controlled lift.

props.name: Set distance
props.headline: Set distance
props.detail: Your sets peak {value} {unit} from the net (target {target}). Face the net and lift the ball up, not across.

props.name: Net or arm touch
props.headline: Net or arm touch
props.detail: You touched the net, post or ball with an arm {value} time(s). Stay balanced and keep the arms clear.

props.name: Set height
props.headline: Set height
props.detail: Your sets peak {value} {unit} above the net (target {target}). Agree the height your striker wants and repeat it.

props.name: Contact height
props.headline: Contact height
props.detail: You contact the ball at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Agree a consistent throw height with your thrower.

props.name: Contact varies
props.headline: Contact varies
props.detail: Your contact height varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Work with the thrower on the same throw every time.

props.name: Serve speed
props.headline: Serve speed
props.detail: Your serve leaves at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Swing the leg through fast and contact the ball with a firm foot.

props.name: Serve not in
props.headline: Serve not in
props.detail: {value} serve(s) did not cross the net or landed out. Aim for a safe target area first, then add speed.

props.name: Support foot fault
props.headline: Support foot fault
props.detail: On {value} serve(s) your support foot lifted or left the circle before contact. Keep it planted until the ball has gone.

props.name: Leaning forward
props.headline: Leaning forward
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward (target {target}). Keep the chest up and look where you are going.

props.name: Stiff front leg
props.headline: Stiff front leg
props.detail: The front knee bends {value} {unit} as you push (target {target}). Bend the front knee so the pushing foot reaches the ground easily.

props.name: Uneven pushes
props.headline: Uneven pushes
props.detail: Your push timing varies by {value} (target {target}). Push, glide, push, glide at an even beat.

props.name: Weight off the middle
props.headline: Weight off the middle
props.detail: The hips are {value} body-heights off the middle of the board (target {target}). Keep the hips between your feet.

props.name: Foot position
props.headline: Foot position
props.detail: The feet are {value} times your height apart (target {target}). Stand with the feet about shoulder-width, over the bolts.

props.name: Standing stiff
props.headline: Standing stiff
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} while rolling (target {target}). Keep the knees soft so you can absorb bumps.

props.name: Low ollie
props.headline: Low ollie
props.detail: Your feet rise {value} of your height (target {target}). Pop the tail, slide the front foot up the board and lift the knees.

props.name: Pause before the pop
props.headline: Pause before the pop
props.detail: You wait {value} {unit} at the bottom of the crouch (target {target}). Crouch and snap the tail down in one quick movement.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Land with both feet over the bolts and bend the knees.

props.name: Little lean into the turn
props.headline: Little lean into the turn
props.detail: You lean {value} {unit} into the turn (target {target}). Tip the skis on edge by moving the knees and hips into the turn, at a speed you control.

props.name: Upper body turns with the skis
props.headline: Upper body turns with the skis
props.detail: The upper body faces {value} {unit} towards the outside of the turn (target {target}). Keep the chest facing more down the slope while the legs turn.

props.name: Straight legs
props.headline: Straight legs
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} in the turn (target {target}). Stay flexed in the ankles and knees so you can absorb the snow.

props.name: Uneven turns
props.headline: Uneven turns
props.detail: Your turn length varies by {value} (target {target}). Link turns of the same size and rhythm; count a steady beat.

props.name: Not enough weight on the outside ski
props.headline: Not enough weight on the outside ski
props.detail: The hips move {value} body-heights towards the outside ski (target {target}). Press on the outside foot to turn: heavy outside foot, light inside foot.

props.name: Straight legs
props.headline: Straight legs
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} (target {target}). Bend the ankles and knees so the shins press into the boots.

props.name: Wedge size
props.headline: Wedge size
props.detail: The feet are {value} times your height apart in the snowplough (target {target}). Keep a steady wedge, tips close and tails apart, wide enough to control speed.

props.name: Weight off the centre
props.headline: Weight off the centre
props.detail: The hips sit {value} body-heights off the middle of the board (target {target}). Keep the hips between the feet, slightly over the front foot as you start each turn.

props.name: Straight legs
props.headline: Straight legs
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} through the turns (target {target}). Ride with soft, bent knees and ankles to stay balanced.

props.name: Shoulders twisted
props.headline: Shoulders twisted
props.detail: The shoulders twist {value} {unit} away from the board (target {target}). Keep the shoulders in line with the board and turn the head to look ahead.

props.name: Uneven turns
props.headline: Uneven turns
props.detail: Your turn length varies by {value} (target {target}). Link heelside and toeside turns of the same size.

props.name: Front knee moves inward
props.headline: Front knee moves inward
props.detail: The front knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot (target {target}). Point the knee over the middle toes as you lunge.

props.name: Leaning forward
props.headline: Leaning forward
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward at the bottom (target {target}). Keep the chest up so you can push back quickly.

props.name: Shallow lunge
props.headline: Shallow lunge
props.detail: The front knee bends {value} {unit} at the bottom of the lunge (target {target}). Take a longer last step and sink lower to reach the ball.

props.name: Slow push back
props.headline: Slow push back
props.detail: You stay in the lunge for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Drive off the front foot back towards the T straight after the shot.

props.name: Contact height
props.headline: Contact height
props.detail: You hit the serve {value} body-heights from shoulder level (target {target}). For a lob serve, contact the ball between waist and shoulder with an open face.

props.name: Foot fault
props.headline: Foot fault
props.detail: {value} serve(s) had no foot wholly inside the service box at contact. Keep one foot inside the box, clear of the lines, as you hit. In a match the referee decides.

props.name: Arm position at impact
props.headline: Arm position at impact
props.detail: The elbow is bent {value} {unit} at impact (target {target}). Hit with a slightly bent, relaxed arm, the ball out in front and to the side.

props.name: Wrist not cocked
props.headline: Wrist not cocked
props.detail: The wrist is cocked back {value} {unit} at impact (target {target}). Keep the wrist cocked with the racket head up through the swing.

props.name: Swing speed varies
props.headline: Swing speed varies
props.detail: Your racket speed varies by {value} from shot to shot (target {target}). Use the same compact swing every time; control matters more than power.

props.name: Standing tall at impact
props.headline: Standing tall at impact
props.detail: The front knee bends {value} {unit} at impact (target {target}). Step in and bend the front knee to get down to the ball.

props.name: Chest too high
props.headline: Chest too high
props.detail: Your chest is lifted {value} {unit} off the board (target {target}). Lie lower with the chest close to the board; lift the head, not the back.

props.name: High arm recovery
props.headline: High arm recovery
props.detail: Your hands lift {value} {unit} out of the water (target {target}). Keep the recovery low and close to the water.

props.name: Slow stroke rate
props.headline: Slow stroke rate
props.detail: Each arm stroke takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Keep the arms turning over, one entering as the other finishes.

props.name: Uneven strokes
props.headline: Uneven strokes
props.detail: Your stroke time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Find a steady rhythm before sprinting.

props.name: Speed and flow
props.headline: Speed and flow
props.detail: Your turn was rated {value} for speed and flow (target {target}). Carry speed from the take-off into a smooth, committed turn.

props.name: Lead with your head
props.headline: Lead with your head
props.detail: Your head and shoulders were rated {value} for leading the turn (target {target}). Look where you want to go first.

props.name: Standing tall
props.headline: Standing tall
props.detail: Your front knee is at {value} {unit} at the bottom of the turn (target {target}). Bend lower to load the rail, then extend up the face.

props.name: Pop-up varies
props.headline: Pop-up varies
props.detail: Your pop-up time varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use the same hand position and sequence every time.

props.name: Landing knees
props.headline: Landing knees
props.detail: Your front knee is at {value} {unit} as you land (target {target}). Land with soft, bent knees, low and balanced.

props.name: Slow pop-up
props.headline: Slow pop-up
props.detail: Your pop-up takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push up strongly with hands by the chest, then bring both feet through in one move.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: Your feet land {value} {unit} apart (target {target}, about shoulder width or a little wider). Land on the board's centre line in a balanced stance.

props.name: Glide timing
props.headline: Glide timing
props.detail: The glide after each kick lasts {value} {unit} (target {target}). Hold a short streamline before the next pull.

props.name: Hands pull back past the hips
props.headline: Hands pull back past the hips
props.detail: The hands come back past the hip line on {value} stroke(s). Keep the pull in front of the shoulders, except on the first stroke off the wall.

props.name: Legs not kicking together
props.headline: Legs not kicking together
props.detail: On {value} kick(s) the legs do not move together. Kick both feet out and round at the same time.

props.name: Pull and kick out of order
props.headline: Pull and kick out of order
props.detail: {value} cycle(s) are not one arm stroke then one leg kick. Think 'pull, kick, glide'. In a race the judges decide.

props.name: Stroke rhythm
props.headline: Stroke rhythm
props.detail: Each stroke cycle takes {value} {unit} at this pace (target {target}). Keep an even, relaxed rhythm.

props.name: Lifting the head to breathe
props.headline: Lifting the head to breathe
props.detail: The head lifts {value} body-heights when you breathe (target {target}). Turn the head with the body roll, keeping one goggle in the water.

props.name: Body roll
props.headline: Body roll
props.detail: The shoulders roll {value} {unit} each side (target {target}). Roll from the shoulders and hips together with each stroke.

props.name: Short strokes
props.headline: Short strokes
props.detail: You travel {value} body-heights per stroke cycle (target {target}). Reach forward, catch early and push back past the hip.

props.name: Arms bent in the streamline
props.headline: Arms bent in the streamline
props.detail: The elbows are at {value} {unit} after the push-off (target {target}). Squeeze the arms straight behind the ears, one hand on top of the other.

props.name: Head surfaces after 15 m
props.headline: Head surfaces after 15 m
props.detail: The head breaks the surface about {value} {unit} from the wall. In freestyle, backstroke and butterfly it must surface by 15 m. In a race the judges decide.

props.name: Body not in a straight line
props.headline: Body not in a straight line
props.detail: The body bends {value} {unit} at the hips in the streamline (target {target}). Make a long, straight line from fingertips to toes.

props.name: Contact point
props.headline: Contact point
props.detail: The bat meets the ball {value} body-heights in front of the hips (target {target}). Meet the ball in front of the body, in line with your centre.

props.name: Elbow tucked in
props.headline: Elbow tucked in
props.detail: The playing elbow is {value} body-heights in front of the shoulders (target {target}). Hold the elbow forward, away from the body.

props.name: Long swing
props.headline: Long swing
props.detail: The bat travels {value} body-heights into contact (target {target}). Use a short, compact swing from in front of the body.

props.name: Knee bend
props.headline: Knee bend
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}).

props.name: Contact point
props.headline: Contact point
props.detail: The bat meets the ball {value} body-heights in front of the hips (target {target}). Move your feet so you hit the ball in front of the body.

props.name: Arm-only topspin
props.headline: Arm-only topspin
props.detail: The hips turn {value} {unit} through the stroke (target {target}). Turn the hips and trunk into the ball, then let the arm follow.

props.name: Slow forward swing
props.headline: Slow forward swing
props.detail: The forward swing takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Accelerate through the ball, brushing up and forward.

props.name: Standing tall
props.headline: Standing tall
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} at the end of the backswing (target {target}). Bend the knees and load the playing-side leg.

props.name: Ball drops below the table
props.headline: Ball drops below the table
props.detail: The ball drops below the playing surface {value} time(s) before you strike it. Toss and strike with the ball above table height.

props.name: Ball goes over the table before the strike
props.headline: Ball goes over the table before the strike
props.detail: The ball moves in front of the end line {value} time(s) before you strike it. Keep the ball behind the end line throughout the service.

props.name: Toss not straight up
props.headline: Toss not straight up
props.detail: The toss leaves {value} {unit} away from vertical (target {target}). Lift the ball straight up from a flat, open palm.

props.name: Toss below 16 cm
props.headline: Toss below 16 cm
props.detail: The ball rises about {value} {unit} after leaving the palm. The Laws require at least 16 cm. In a match the umpire decides.

props.name: Cramped at contact
props.headline: Cramped at contact
props.detail: The front arm is bent {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Give yourself room and extend through the ball.

props.name: Contact too late
props.headline: Contact too late
props.detail: The ball is struck {absValue} body-heights behind the front hip (target {target}). Turn early and meet the ball in front.

props.name: Small shoulder turn
props.headline: Small shoulder turn
props.detail: The shoulders turn {value} {unit} to the baseline (target {target}). Turn the shoulders as soon as you see a backhand.

props.name: Legs straight in the backswing
props.headline: Legs straight in the backswing
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} (target {target}). Get low to the ball.

props.name: Swinging with the arm only
props.headline: Swinging with the arm only
props.detail: Hips and shoulders separate by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Let the hips start the forward swing.

props.name: Head moves through contact
props.headline: Head moves through contact
props.detail: The head travels {value} body-heights between backswing and contact (target {target}). Keep the head still at contact.

props.name: Contact too late
props.headline: Contact too late
props.detail: The ball is struck {absValue} body-heights behind the front hip (target {target}). Prepare earlier and meet the ball in front.

props.name: Small shoulder turn
props.headline: Small shoulder turn
props.detail: The shoulders turn {value} {unit} to the baseline (target {target}). Turn the shoulders early with the racket.

props.name: Legs straight in the backswing
props.headline: Legs straight in the backswing
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} (target {target}). Sit into the shot to use the legs.

props.name: Narrow landing
props.headline: Narrow landing
props.detail: The feet land {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}). Land a little wider to push off either way.

props.name: Slow first step
props.headline: Slow first step
props.detail: The first step comes {value} {unit} after landing (target {target}). Push off straight out of the split step.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} on landing (target {target}). Land softly, ready to move.

props.name: Elbow bent at contact
props.headline: Elbow bent at contact
props.detail: The hitting elbow is bent {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Extend up to meet the ball at full reach.

props.name: Very deep knee bend
props.headline: Very deep knee bend
props.detail: The front knee bends {value} {unit} (target {target}), which can slow the upward drive.

props.name: Foot fault
props.headline: Foot fault
props.detail: A foot touches or crosses the baseline ({value} body-heights past it) before the ball is struck. Keep both feet behind the line until contact.

props.name: Contact height varies
props.headline: Contact height varies
props.detail: Contact height varies by {value} of standing height across serves (target {target}). Work on a repeatable toss.

props.name: Little knee bend in the loading
props.headline: Little knee bend in the loading
props.detail: The front knee bends {value} {unit} at the trophy position (target {target}). Bend the knees to drive up into the ball.

props.name: Hitting arm low at contact
props.headline: Hitting arm low at contact
props.detail: The hitting arm is elevated {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Reach up to the ball.

props.name: Low contact point
props.headline: Low contact point
props.detail: Contact is at {value} times standing height (target {target}). Toss higher and hit at full stretch.

props.name: Trunk tilt at the trophy position
props.headline: Trunk tilt at the trophy position
props.detail: The trunk is inclined {value} {unit} at the trophy position (target {target}).

props.name: Drifting sideways
props.headline: Drifting sideways
props.detail: You drift {value} of your height sideways on the approach (target {target}). Walk straight towards your target board.

props.name: Step count changes
props.headline: Step count changes
props.detail: {value} deliveries used a different number of steps. Use the same four- or five-step approach every time.

props.name: Uneven steps
props.headline: Uneven steps
props.detail: Your step timing varies by {value} (target {target}). Walk a smooth rhythm that builds into the slide.

props.name: Backswing height
props.headline: Backswing height
props.detail: The ball reaches {value} of your height at the top of the backswing (target {target}). Push the ball out and let gravity set the backswing; don't lift or muscle it.

props.name: Bent arm at release
props.headline: Bent arm at release
props.detail: The ball-arm elbow is at {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Keep the arm long and relaxed through the release.

props.name: Swing off line
props.headline: Swing off line
props.detail: The ball hand drifts {value} of your height off a straight swing (target {target}). Let the ball swing like a pendulum, straight back and straight through towards your target.

props.name: Foul line
props.headline: Foul line
props.detail: You touch on or beyond the foul line {value} time(s). Start your approach a little further back so the slide stops before the line.

props.name: Wobbly finish
props.headline: Wobbly finish
props.detail: It takes {value} {unit} to settle after release (target {target}). Finish facing the target with the opposite arm out and the ball-side leg behind, and hold it.

props.name: Trunk angle at release
props.headline: Trunk angle at release
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward at release (target {target}). Keep the chest over the slide knee with a long back.

props.name: Standing tall at release
props.headline: Standing tall at release
props.detail: The slide knee bends {value} {unit} at release (target {target}). Bend the slide knee to get low as the ball passes the ankle.

props.name: Forward pass
props.headline: Forward pass
props.detail: {value} pass(es) went forward. Pass flat or behind, and let the receiver run onto it.

props.name: Turn to the receiver
props.headline: Turn to the receiver
props.detail: Your shoulders turn {value} {unit} towards the receiver (target {target}). Turn your chest towards them as you pass.

props.name: Follow through to the target
props.headline: Follow through to the target
props.detail: Your hands travel {value} of your height towards the receiver (target {target}). Finish with the hands pointing at the target.

props.name: Too slow after the tag
props.headline: Too slow after the tag
props.detail: You passed {value} {unit} after being tagged; the limit is 3 seconds. Look for your support before the tag and pass as you stop.

props.name: Not facing the try line
props.headline: Not facing the try line
props.detail: You are turned {value} {unit} away from the try line (target {target}). Face up the field, parallel to the sideline.

props.name: Not on the mark
props.headline: Not on the mark
props.detail: {value} rollball(s) were not on the mark. Stop on the spot where you were touched before placing the ball.

props.name: Ball rolled too far
props.headline: Ball rolled too far
props.detail: The ball rolled back {value} {unit}, more than the 1 m allowed. Place it between your feet and step over it, or roll it back gently.

props.name: Slow rollball
props.headline: Slow rollball
props.detail: Your rollball takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Stop, place and step over in one movement.

props.name: Knee moves inward at the step
props.headline: Knee moves inward at the step
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot as you plant (target {target}). Aim to keep the knee over the middle toes.

props.name: Leaning away from the step
props.headline: Leaning away from the step
props.detail: Your trunk leans {value} {unit} away from your new direction (target {target}). Keep your chest over the plant foot.

props.name: Plant-leg bend
props.headline: Plant-leg bend
props.detail: Your plant knee bends {value} {unit} (target {target}). Sink onto the plant leg, then drive away.

props.name: Slow step
props.headline: Slow step
props.detail: Your plant foot stays down {value} {unit} (target {target}). Plant and push off in one quick movement.

props.name: Too close to the thrower
props.headline: Too close to the thrower
props.detail: You come within one disc diameter of the thrower {value} time(s). Keep a disc's width away from their body. In a game, players make the call.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: The feet are {value} times your height apart (target {target}). Keep the feet about shoulder-width apart on the balls of the feet.

props.name: Standing tall on the mark
props.headline: Standing tall on the mark
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} on the mark (target {target}). Sit lower with the knees bent so you can shuffle quickly.

props.name: Arm action out of sequence
props.headline: Arm action out of sequence
props.detail: The elbow peaks {value} {unit} after the shoulder (target {target}). Let the body turn pull the arm through, then snap the wrist.

props.name: Little body turn
props.headline: Little body turn
props.detail: The trunk turns {value} {unit} into the throw (target {target}). Wind the disc back across the body and turn the hips and shoulders through.

props.name: Short step out
props.headline: Short step out
props.detail: The step is {value} times your height (target {target}). Step out wide from the pivot to release away from the mark.

props.name: Pivot foot moves
props.headline: Pivot foot moves
props.detail: The pivot foot lifts or slides {value} time(s) before you release. Keep the pivot foot planted until the disc has gone. In a game, players make the call.

props.name: Little wrist snap
props.headline: Little wrist snap
props.detail: The wrist moves {value} {unit} through the flick (target {target}). Cock the wrist back, push the elbow forward and snap the wrist for spin.

props.name: Short step out
props.headline: Short step out
props.detail: The step is {value} times your height (target {target}). Step wide to the throwing-hand side and sink into the pivot.

props.name: Side-on at release
props.headline: Side-on at release
props.detail: The chest is turned {value} {unit} away from the target at release (target {target}). Keep the hips and chest facing the receiver.

props.name: Pivot foot moves
props.headline: Pivot foot moves
props.detail: The pivot foot lifts or slides {value} time(s) before you release. Keep the pivot foot planted until the disc has gone. In a game, players make the call.

props.name: Ball behind the hitting shoulder
props.headline: Ball behind the hitting shoulder
props.detail: The hand meets the ball {absValue} body-heights behind the hitting shoulder (target {target}). Start the approach a little later so the ball is in front.

props.name: Knee moves inward on landing
props.headline: Knee moves inward on landing
props.detail: The knee drifts {value} {unit} inside the line of the foot as you land (target {target}). Keep the knees over the middle toes.

props.name: Hitting the ball low
props.headline: Hitting the ball low
props.detail: The hitting hand is at {value} times your height at contact (target {target}). Time the approach so you meet the ball at full reach.

props.name: Short time in the air
props.headline: Short time in the air
props.detail: You are in the air for {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use a fast last step and swing both arms up hard.

props.name: Knee bend at the plant
props.headline: Knee bend at the plant
props.detail: The knees are at {value} {unit} at the end of the approach (target {target}). Sink into the last two steps, then drive up.

props.name: Stiff landing
props.headline: Stiff landing
props.detail: The knees bend only {value} {unit} after landing (target {target}). Land softly on both feet and let the hips and knees bend.

props.name: Arms swing up after contact
props.headline: Arms swing up after contact
props.detail: The hands finish {value} body-heights above the shoulders (target {target}). Angle the platform and push with the legs instead of swinging the arms.

props.name: Bent elbows at contact
props.headline: Bent elbows at contact
props.detail: The elbows are at {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Join the hands and straighten the arms into a flat platform.

props.name: Contact point height
props.headline: Contact point height
props.detail: The ball is played {value} body-heights from hip height (target {target}). Move your feet to get behind and under the ball.

props.name: Stance width
props.headline: Stance width
props.detail: The feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}).

props.name: Standing tall in the ready position
props.headline: Standing tall in the ready position
props.detail: The knees bend {value} {unit} in the ready position (target {target}). Get low with the weight on the balls of the feet.

props.name: Bent arm at contact
props.headline: Bent arm at contact
props.detail: The elbow is at {value} {unit} at contact (target {target}). Reach up and hit through the middle of the ball.

props.name: Ball behind the hitting shoulder
props.headline: Ball behind the hitting shoulder
props.detail: The hand meets the ball {absValue} body-heights behind the hitting shoulder (target {target}). Toss the ball a little further in front.

props.name: High toss
props.headline: High toss
props.detail: The ball rises {value} body-heights above the contact point (target {target}). Use a low, steady toss in front of the hitting shoulder.

props.name: Low contact
props.headline: Low contact
props.detail: The hand is at {value} times your height at contact (target {target}). Reach up to meet the ball.

props.name: Toss changes from serve to serve
props.headline: Toss changes from serve to serve
props.detail: Toss height varies by {value} body-heights across serves (target {target}).

props.name: Bar swings forward
props.headline: Bar swings forward
props.detail: The bar moves {value} body-heights forward of its start during the pull (target {target}). Keep the bar brushing close to the legs and hips.

props.name: Pull not finished
props.headline: Pull not finished
props.detail: The knees reach {value} {unit} at the top of the pull (target {target}). Finish the drive with straight legs before pulling under.

props.name: Press-out
props.headline: Press-out
props.detail: The arms are still straightening after you reach the bottom of the catch ({value} time(s)). Punch the arms to locked as you pull under. In competition the referees decide.

props.name: Unstable catch
props.headline: Unstable catch
props.detail: You take {value} steps to steady the bar. Catch with the bar over the mid-foot and stand up with the feet in line.

props.name: Bar away from the shins
props.headline: Bar away from the shins
props.detail: The bar starts {value} body-heights from the shins (target {target}). Set up with the bar over the mid-foot, close to the shins.

props.name: Bar dips before lockout
props.headline: Bar dips before lockout
props.detail: The bar moves down {value} time(s) before the finish. Pull in one continuous movement. In a meet the referees decide.

props.name: Hips rise first
props.headline: Hips rise first
props.detail: The hips rise {value} times as fast as the shoulders off the floor (target {target}). Push the floor away with the legs so hips and shoulders rise together.

props.name: Not fully upright at the finish
props.headline: Not fully upright at the finish
props.detail: The knees are at {value} {unit} at the finish (target {target}). Stand fully tall with straight legs and the shoulders back. In a meet the referees decide.

props.name: Not deep enough for competition
props.headline: Not deep enough for competition
props.detail: At the bottom the hip joint is {value} body-heights above the top of the knee. Competition squats need the hip crease below the knee top. In a meet the referees decide.

props.name: Bar drifts off the mid-foot
props.headline: Bar drifts off the mid-foot
props.detail: The bar is {value} body-heights off the mid-foot at the bottom (target {target}). Keep the bar stacked over the middle of the foot.

props.name: Bar dips on the way up
props.headline: Bar dips on the way up
props.detail: The bar moves down {value} time(s) during the ascent. Drive up in one continuous movement. In a meet the referees decide.

props.name: Chest drops forward
props.headline: Chest drops forward
props.detail: The trunk leans {value} {unit} forward at the bottom (target {target}). Brace, keep the chest up and push the floor away.

props.name: Knees move inward
props.headline: Knees move inward
props.detail: The knees drift {value} {unit} inside the line of the feet as you rise (target {target}). Push the knees out over the toes.

props.name: Slow turn
props.headline: Slow turn
props.detail: Your turn takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Push one rim forward and pull the other back at the same time.

props.name: Chair tipped
props.headline: Chair tipped

props.name: Wide turn
props.headline: Wide turn
props.detail: Your chair drifts {value} of your height as you turn (target {target}). Pivot on the spot.

props.name: Off the seat
props.headline: Off the seat
props.detail: You lifted off the seat {value} time(s), which is a foul. Stay seated; adjust strapping with your coach if needed.

props.name: Push rhythm
props.headline: Push rhythm
props.detail: Each push cycle takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). Use quick, full pushes and get your hands back to the top of the rims.

props.name: Travelling
props.headline: Travelling
props.detail: You took more than two pushes while holding the ball {value} time(s). Push twice with the ball on your lap, then bounce it.

props.name: Uneven pushes
props.headline: Uneven pushes
props.detail: One side gives {value} of the drive (target {target}). Push evenly with both hands to keep a straight line.

props.name: Shot arc
props.headline: Shot arc
props.detail: Your shots leave at {value} {unit} (target {target}, adjusted with your coach for your class). Push up through the ball for a clear arc.

props.name: Inconsistent arc
props.headline: Inconsistent arc
props.detail: Your launch angle varies by {value} {unit} (target {target}). Set the chair at the same angle to the line and use the same routine every shot.

props.name: Off the seat
props.headline: Off the seat
props.detail: You lifted off the seat {value} time(s) while shooting, which is a foul. Generate power from the trunk and arms while staying seated.

props.name: Short follow-through
props.headline: Short follow-through
props.detail: Your elbow finishes at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Extend the arm fully and hold the follow-through.

props.name: Level change
props.headline: Level change
props.detail: You drop {value} of your stance height (target {target}). Change level with the legs, not by bending at the waist; don't dive too low.

props.name: Drive forward
props.headline: Drive forward
props.detail: Your upper body travels {value} {unit} forward (target {target}). Push hard off the back foot and move your chest through early.

props.name: Slow entry
props.headline: Slow entry
props.detail: Your shot takes {value} {unit} from level change to the end of the step (target {target}). Change level and step in one quick action.

props.name: Hips high
props.headline: Hips high
props.detail: Your hips stay at {value} of standing height (target {target}). Drive the hips down to the mat.

props.name: Legs back
props.headline: Legs back
props.detail: Your hips are at {value} {unit} (target {target}). Kick the legs back and wide so the hips open.

props.name: Slow to recover
props.headline: Slow to recover
props.detail: You take {value} {unit} to get back to stance (target {target}). Snap the feet back under you and return to your stance.

props.name: Slow sprawl
props.headline: Slow sprawl
props.detail: Your sprawl takes {value} {unit} (target {target}). React on the call and throw the legs back at once.

props.name: Base width
props.headline: Base width
props.detail: Your feet are {value} times shoulder width apart (target {target}). Keep a balanced base; step, don't cross the feet.

props.name: Bobbing
props.headline: Bobbing
props.detail: Your hip height varies by {value} (target {target}). Stay at the same level as you move.

props.name: Posture
props.headline: Posture
props.detail: Your trunk leans {value} {unit} (target {target}). Chest over the knees, back flat, head up.

props.name: Stance level
props.headline: Stance level
props.detail: Your hips sit at {value} of standing height (target {target}). Bend the knees to a strong, athletic level you can move from.

props.closeBy: Add class-specific bands to the protocol format (engine and schema change), then set bands per class with the coach panel.

props.name: Few numbers, tiny samples
props.title: Few numbers, tiny samples

props.closeBy: Coach panel signs off bands and key skills; calibrate from our own clips across classes, women and juniors.

props.name: World Boccia 2025-2028 rulebook not read in full

props.detail: Needs: ball and jack tracking to rest with court calibration; box and V-line zones; seat-contact detection for seated athletes; ramp tracking (end position and swing range); ramp-operator head direction; ball motion start on a ramp. Pose estimation on seated athletes with impairments needs testing.
props.closeBy: Build detectors and test pose accuracy on seated athletes across classes.

props.name: One band for forehand and backhand, and across classes

props.title: Head-safety wording and safeguarding review

props.bandReference: Feet about shoulder-width apart; provisional band

props.bandReference: Stay low and drive forward out of the stance; provisional band

props.bandReference: B1: about 20 deg, falling to 11 deg at release

props.bandReference: B1: stride knee flexes from 29 to 46 deg, peaking at release
